jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – AI Agents & Enterprise Software
jobs.jd: You love building something people can actually use: the moment an integration works, an agent takes a tedious task off someone’s hands, or an idea becomes a useful tool. At XALT, you work closely with the people you build for, taking their solution from the first conversation into production. Your customers will be enterprises and public-sector organisations. Your focus will be AI agents with XALT Northstar or development platforms in the Atlassian ecosystem. We will work out together which area fits your experience and interests; working across both is possible. What you learn in customer projects will feed back into our own products. What we are working towards We want to help companies use AI to improve the work people rely on every day. We combine consulting, software development and our own products to make that happen. What excites us is seeing a technical idea become something people can count on. What you will do Turn business problems into practical technical solutions together with the customer. Write production code and integrate agents into existing systems and workflows. With a Northstar focus, build and operate personal and operational agents using MCP servers, Agent Skills, evals, guardrails and observability. With an Atlassian focus, develop platforms and workflows using Forge, Rovo and CI/CD so development teams can use agents reliably. Take solutions into production, evaluate their quality and improve them based on actual use. Bring insights from customer projects into our products. What you bring Experience writing and reviewing production code, for example in TypeScript or Python, across both backend and frontend Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers and CI/CD, for example AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform or GitLab Practical experience with LLMs and agentic systems, including evals that detect errors and regressions At least one agent or AI workflow you have built yourself and put into production , which you can demonstrate live during the application process (see “Your AI example”) Enjoyment of working directly with customers and the ability to make reasoned technical decisions with incomplete information Business-fluent German and English What we offer Unlimited tokens for Claude, OpenAI and the latest, most advanced AI tools €70,000–100,000 gross per year , depending on experience; we are open to going beyond this range for exceptional senior candidates with a proven record of running agents in production The opportunity to follow your solutions from the first conversation into customers’ daily work and see the difference they make Professional exchange within the team, across the Atlassian ecosystem as a Platinum Partner, and through the XALT AI Circle and IT Revolution Your working arrangements We value working together in the office: developing ideas, learning from one another and talking things through in person. Living in or around Munich or Leipzig is therefore a plus. Remote work is also possible. If you live further away, we would still love to hear from you. Together, we will discuss an arrangement that works for you, your team and the role. Full-time Work within an international company with teams in Munich, Leipzig, Manila and New York Our professional community Exchanging ideas with others is part of what we enjoy about this work. For our XALT AI Circle in Munich in autumn 2026, we have invited Peter Steinberger of the OpenClaw Foundation to discuss personal agents. In October 2026, Philipp Göllner spoke at the Enterprise AI Summit in Charlotte about how our team built a Chief of Staff agent. We plan to represent XALT again at the summit in Portland in May 2027. For a closer look at our work, see Philipp’s talk from Charlotte. Your AI example We would like to understand how you approach problems and what you have learned along the way. Bring a process you have automated yourself with AI and show it to us live. Walk us through your contribution, whether the workflow works consistently, and what has measurably improved. We are also interested in its limitations and how you check the results. One example is enough; you can recreate it with test data. Please do not share confidential information or protected code. Your application Does this sound like work you would enjoy? We would love to hear from you. Send your CV to ----- and tell us what you would like to work on. The conversation should also give you room to ask about the team, your responsibilities and what you need to do good work. We will discuss the interview arrangements and your AI demonstration with you personally. You can also send any questions beforehand to ----- Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

This role requires a strong combination of AI research, hands-on model training and optimization, and software engineering expertise, with the ability to translate innovative AI concepts into scalable, reliable, and practical business applications. Working closely with software engineers, product teams, and leadership, the AI Engineer will lead the development and integration of high-performance AI solutions that solve complex business challenges, enhance operational efficiency, and deliver measurable value to our global clients. Select appropriate models and architectures while balancing accuracy, latency, cost, and complexity. Train and fine-tune models using PyTorch or Keras, including data preparation and evaluation. Implement and benchmark research methods before adoption. Build APIs, inference pipelines, and backend integrations. Production & Optimization Own evaluation of metrics and track quality, latency, and cost. Monitor, debug, and optimize AI systems post-launch. Ensure production readiness and identify regressions before they impact users. Collaboration Partner with software engineers and product teams to integrate AI into applications. Contribute to technical discussions and technical decision-making. Document architecture, implementation approaches, and key technical decisions. Contribute to continued innovation across AI and engineering initiatives. Working Relationships The AI Engineer will collaborate with: Engineering leadership and product teams. Software engineers and backend developers. Global AI research and development teams. Success in This Role Success means you can build with AI and deliver reliable production solutions, not simply experiment with AI models. You should be able to: Deliver production-ready AI systems with measurable impact. Translate research into practical engineering solutions. Collaborate effectively across distributed teams. Document and share technical knowledge for scalability. Adapt to evolving technical and business priorities. Work Environment This is a fully remote position based in India. Candidates should be comfortable working independently and collaborating with globally distributed teams across different time zones. Required Work Schedule This AI Engineer role requires working Monday through Friday, 7:30 PM–4:30 AM or 8:30 PM–5:30 AM IST in India, depending on U.S. daylight saving time? Due to project deadlines, production needs, client requirements, or other business priorities, occasional weekend availability or schedule adjustments may be required. Weekend work is not intended to be the standard schedule but flexibility to support business needs when necessary is expected Our Hiring Process We value your time and aim to keep our recruitment process transparent, efficient, and engaging. 1. Initial Recruiter Screening An introductory video call with a member of our Recruiting team to discuss your background, experience, career goals, salary expectations, and any initial questions you may have about the role or Volga Partners . 2. Practical Skills Assessment Candidates who successfully complete the initial screening will receive a practical assessment to complete asynchronously. The assessment is designed to evaluate technical knowledge, problem-solving ability, and how you approach a real-world engineering scenario. 3. Assessment Review Our team will review your submission against the technical requirements of the role. Candidates who meet the required criteria will advance to the final interview stage. 4. Technical / Coding Interview Candidates who pass the assessment will meet with our Engineering team to further evaluate their technical skills, experience, and AI Engineering knowledge 5. Final Interview – CTO A deep-dive conversation with our Chief Technology Officer focused on technical alignment, your assessment approach, architectural thinking, problem-solving, and overall alignment with the role and team. Requirements Required Qualifications 3+ years of hands-on AI/ML engineering experience, with at least one system deployed to production. Strong NLP fundamentals, including tokenization, embeddings, classification, NER, and information extraction. Strong engineering skills across coding, Git, testing, API/system design, and debugging. Hands-on model training experience using PyTorch or Keras. Understanding generative model architectures, including Transformers and VAEs. Production experience with LLMs, including RAG, embeddings/vector databases, and prompt/evaluation design. Experience with FastAPI or similar frameworks, Docker, and at least one cloud platform such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. Ability to read ML research papers and translate ideas into working code. Preferred Qualifications Experience with LLM fine-tuning, including LoRA and RL-based methods. SQL database knowledge. Familiarity with agent framework

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.location: San Jose, California, United States of America
jobs.jd: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: This job will lead the development and implementation of advanced data science models and algorithms. You will work with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions. Your role involves driving best practices in data science, ensuring data quality, and mentoring junior scientists. Job Description: PayPal, Inc. seeks Senior Data Scientist in San Jose, CA Job Duties: Design and execute controlled experiments to measure the effectiveness of PayPal's Agentic Commerce offering across LLM platforms. Apply causal inference methodologies to attribute revenue and conversion changes to product features in AI-driven checkout flows. Develop behavioral models to understand merchant and consumer interactions within conversational commerce environments. Build measurement frameworks to track key performance metrics across growth, conversion, latency, availability, and friction for emerging AI commerce channels. Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to optimize the Agentic Commerce experience based on data-driven insights. Partial telecommuting permitted from within a commutable distance. EOE, including disability/vets. The base pay for this role will depend on where you work and the relevant experience and expertise you bring. The expected range of pay for this role by location is: Primary Location | Pay Range: San Jose, CA | Salary: $144,991.00-243,500.00 per annum. 40 hours per week; M-F, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Additional compensation for this role may include an annual performance bonus, equity, or other incentive compensation, as applicable. Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : Minimum Requirements: Master’s degree, or foreign equivalent, in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, or a closely related field plus two years of experience in the job offered or a related occupation. Special Skill Requirements: Experience using Python and SQL for data analysis, querying databases, and machine learning (2 years). Experience with statistical analysis, probability, hypothesis testing, parametric & non-parametric tests, A/B testing frameworks and product analytics (2 years). Experience with Bayesian Statistics and Mixed Effect Modeling to measure Product launches. (2 years). Experience with machine learning and predictive modeling, including scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch for building and deploying models (2 years). Experience with data visualization, Tableau, Looker, Plotly, Dash and Matplotlib/Seaborn for presenting insights (2 years). Experience with ETL pipelines, data warehouses to work efficiently with structured and unstructured data (2 years). Experience translating data insights into actionable business strategies and communicating findings to stakeholders (2 years). Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure for cloud computing, storage, and model deployment (2 years). Experience working with PySpark and Hadoop for handling large-scale datasets (1 years). Experience with probabilities modeling using Monte Carlo simulation and related stochastic techniques (1 years). jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Systems
jobs.jd: We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build NeMo Platform, NVIDIA ’s product for developing, evaluating, deploying, and operating AI systems at scale. This role will focus on NeMo Evaluator, which helps teams understand whether changes to AI agents are making those agents better. As AI systems become more autonomous and more deeply integrated into real workflows, teams need practical infrastructure for observing behavior, measuring progress, catching regressions, and iterating with confidence. Our roadmap is increasingly focused on agentic development and automated agent improvement: giving teams the infrastructure they need to compare versions, understand behavior, and make empirically grounded improvements over time. What you'll be doing: Design and implement Python-first APIs, SDK workflows, and plugin interfaces for building, measuring, and improving agents across multiple runtimes and product surfaces Build reusable systems for observing behavior, measuring progress, detecting regressions, and turning runtime evidence into product decisions Build systems for ingesting, normalizing, validating, and analyzing agent execution data and evaluation datasets Partner with research, product, platform, and infrastructure teams to integrate agentic capabilities broadly across NVIDIA agent runtimes and developer workflows Help turn emerging agent development and improvement techniques into reliable, reusable product capabilities Improve reliability, observability, debuggability, and performance across NeMo Platform, SDKs, plugins, jobs, and developer workflows Build strong test coverage across unit, integration, E2E, Docker, and Kubernetes workflows Drive “speed of light” engineering: fast iteration, high ownership, pragmatic decisions, and performance-minded implementation under production constraints Provide senior technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and ownership of ambiguous cross-component problems What we need to see: BS, MS, or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field 5+ years of professional software engineering experience building production systems Excellent Python engineering skills, including API design, typing, testing, debugging, performance analysis, and maintainable software design Experience designing SDKs, libraries, plugins, CLIs, or other developer-facing interfaces Experience with distributed systems, cloud-native services, containers, Kubernetes, or job orchestration Strong understanding of reliability, scalability, security, and performance tradeoffs in production infrastructure Experience with structured data modeling and validation systems such as Pydantic, typed schemas, event/trace models, or SDK-generated types Ability to work independently, define technical scope, break down ambiguous problems, and drive work across team boundaries Clear communication skills and a track record of collaborating with engineering, product, research, or customer-facing teams Ways to stand out from the crowd: Experience building, deploying, and iterating on production agentic AI systems where evaluation was used to measure and improve real product outcomes Experience designing evaluation workflows for heterogeneous agents, including tool-using agents, RAG agents, workflow agents, coding agents, or long-running autonomous systems Experience integrating evaluation capabilities across multiple products, runtimes, or internal platforms, especially through Python SDKs, plugins, or shared developer tooling Strong ability to connect technical evaluation work to business outcomes, product quality, user experience, reliability, or operational efficiency Experience with enterprise AI systems where measurement, regression testing, observability, governance, and continuous improvement are required for production deployment NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you’re passionate about leading breakthrough AI research and building exceptional teams that shape the future of computing, we want to hear from you. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 10, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - CPG/Retail
jobs.jd:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The position of the Forward Deployed Engineer (Internal Title: Senior Value Engineer) is a trusted advisor helping customers achieve their strategic goals and realise significant value using the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform. A Value Engineer has full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers – landing, expanding, adopting and renewing. Responsibilities include translating customers’ objectives into value assessments or proof-of-value projects, building specific Celonis business cases and demos, running value workshops, and engaging with multiple senior stakeholders to deliver value driven results and secure long term partnership agreements.

You will work in partnership with the Celonis Sales Teams and have full responsibility for the end-to-end value journey of our customers. In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform. You will blend deep process and industry expertise with a proven consulting skill set with strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

The role is based in Munich.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Ranking - Quora
jobs.jd: [ Quora is a privately held, "remote-first" company . This position can be performed remotely from multiple countries around the world. Please visit careers.quora.com/eligible-countries for details regarding employment eligibility by country.] About Quora: Quora’s mission is to grow the world's collective intelligence. To do so, we have two platforms: Quora : a global knowledge sharing platform with millions of monthly unique visitors, bringing people together to share insights on various topics and providing a unique platform to learn and connect with others. Poe : a cloud workspace where millions of users run multiple AI agents on shared context and tools. One subscription, every frontier model, and the collaboration layer that makes them work together. Behind these products are passionate, collaborative, and high-performing global teams. We have a culture rooted in transparency, idea-sharing, and experimentation that allows us to celebrate success and grow together through meaningful work. Join us on this journey to create a positive impact and make a significant change in the world. This role will be working on our Quora product. About the Team and Role: Our small engineering team works on challenging problems every day. We have a culture that's rooted in constantly learning and improving, and our engineers are encouraged to think big and experiment with new ideas. As a remote-first company, our engineers have a high degree of flexibility and autonomy. Everyone on the engineering team has a significant impact on our product and our company. We are looking for an experienced machine learning engineer to join our distribution team, working on recommendation systems such as feed, notifications, and Quora's famous digest emails. At Quora, we use machine learning in almost every part of the product and recommendation systems play an important role in connecting users with content. As a ranking modeling expert, you will own and advance the second-phase ranking model behind feed and digest, one of the highest-leverage surfaces at Quora, by applying the latest machine learning techniques. You will also play a key role in developing methodologies that our other developers will build on top of. Responsibilities: Improve our existing machine learning ranking models using your core coding skills and ML knowledge Take end-to-end ownership of machine learning systems - data pipelines, candidate extraction, feature engineering, model training, as well as integration into our production systems Identify new opportunities to apply machine learning to different parts of the Quora product Work with other machine learning engineers to implement algorithms and systems efficiently Minimum Requirements: Availability for meetings and impromptu communication during Quora's “ coordination hours " (Mon-Fri: 9am-3pm Pacific Time) 3+ years of professional experience working on recommendation or ranking models Good understanding of mathematical foundations of machine learning algorithms Previous experience building end-to-end machine learning systems Good communication and interpersonal skills BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field Preferred Requirements: 5+ years of experience writing Python or C++ code Experience with generative recommendation systems Experience with user behavior or user sequence modeling, transformers, or long sequence modeling applied to ranking Experience with leading large-scale multi-engineer projects Flexible and positive team player with outstanding interpersonal skills Passion for Quora's mission and goals At Quora, we value diversity and inclusivity and welcome individuals from all backgrounds, including marginalized or underrepresented groups in tech, to apply for our job openings. jobs.title: Forecasting Expert
jobs.jd:
About the opportunity:

As a Forecasting Analyst in the WFM team, you are responsible for producing high quality demand forecasts for different workstreams across operations. Your forecasts will be used for capacity planning, budget planning, and shift scheduling of our in-house teams and external partners. Additionally your forecasting expertise will be used to support the implementation of new products and key initiatives, and you will be the internal go-to person for forecasting related questions. You will challenge existing frameworks and implement innovative solutions using your experience and knowledge.

 

In this role, you will:

  • Forecast resource requirements across different teams and workstreams to meet customer/stakeholder demand and required service levels.

  • Produce analytics on forecast performance, as well as volume evolution and the effect of internal or external factors on volume such as new product launches.

  • Assist in the further development of forecasting methodologies, models and tools in order to increase forecast accuracy and efficiency.

  • Partner with Growth, Membership, and Product Teams to understand the key drivers of volume and incorporate them into the forecasting and planning process.

  • Provide consultative support for the leadership team, guiding and advising to develop effective productivity measures, performance management intelligence and resource planning effectiveness.

  • Collaborate with a broad range of analytics teams at N26 to utilise shared platforms, insights and innovations.

  • Maintain an accurate events log detailing what is included in the forecast and reasons for variance to forecast.

 

What you need to be successful:

  • 2+ years of experience working in demand forecasting, resource planning, or directly related field

  • Advanced level of ability in applied mathematics, statistics, scenario modelling, demand modelling and analysis

  • Expert with Excel or Google Sheets, and ability with SQL, Python, or R is a huge plus

  • Experience with business analytics platforms such as Google Looker, Metabase, or similar systems

  • Graduated with a degree in Statistics, Mathematics, or other related field of study/relevant level of professional experience


 

Traits:

  • Actively help yourself (and others) be successful.

  • Continuously learn and challenge the status quo.

  • Think globally, act locally.

  • Strong bias for action.

  • Give and receive open, direct and timely feedback.

jobs.title: LLM Applied Data Scientist (RAG/ NLP)
jobs.jd: Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world. About the Role We are seeking a highly skilled Research Scientist/Engineer to advance the reasoning and planning capabilities of large foundation models. In this role, you will enhance model performance across the entire development lifecycle—including data acquisition, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reward modelling, and reinforcement learning—while driving innovations in reasoning and decision-making. You will synthesise large-scale, high-quality datasets through rewriting, augmentation, and generation techniques to strengthen foundation models during pretraining, SFT, and RL stages. A key part of the role involves solving complex tasks using System 2 thinking and applying advanced decoding strategies such as MCTS and A*. You will design and implement robust evaluation methodologies, teach models to interact with external tools, APIs, and code interpreters, and build agents and multi-agent systems capable of addressing sophisticated real-world problems. Why Binance • Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem • Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure • Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment • Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning • Competitive salary and company benefits • Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team) Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success. By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice. Responsibilities Design, develop, and optimize data processing and retrieval pipelines for enterprise-level generative tasks and mode training applications (Customer Service, Token Report, Web3 Domain Models). This includes embedding, reranking, context engineering, and query rewriting models. Research and evaluate advanced AI-native retrieval algorithms (e.g., low-latency, multimodal retrieval, hierarchical retrieval, GraphRAG) to strengthen large-scale LLM/VLM/Agentic AI capabilities in Binance products. Collaborate with infrastructure and application teams to integrate RAG pipelines into production systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and measurable business impact. Develop and optimize retrieval and ranking pipelines (indexing, vector search, retrieval scoring, reranking) to improve user experience. Participate in LLM training and RAG system , staying current with techniques such as pre-training, SFT, and reinforcement learning, and apply them to retrieval and generation tasks. Apply NLP, CV, and multimodal methods to analyze user-generated content (classification, quality evaluation, trend detection, comment analysis). jobs.title: Prinicipal Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.jd: Your work days are brighter here. We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. About the Team The Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) organization sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, and customer execution across Agent Factory, Sana, Products, and the Developer Platform. When Workday launches new AI agents and products, early deployments surface complex real-world challenges—from unstructured tenant data and intricate configurations to edge-case enterprise workflows. FDE pods deploy directly into active customer engagements to resolve technical friction, debug complex setups, and build lightweight integrations. Crucially, FDEs serve as the primary feedback engine for Product and Engineering: field insights, recurring customer friction, and configuration patterns are converted directly into scalable, out-of-the-box product capabilities. About the Role As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you will bridge hands-on software development with high-impact customer technical strategy. You will partner with enterprise customers to architect, deploy, debug, and optimize Workday’s AI agents and developer platform solutions within live customer environments. Working across the full deployment lifecycle, you will collaborate with AI Deployment Architects, Product Managers, and Workday Services leads. Your primary objective is twofold: drive immediate customer success and eliminate implementation friction over time by embedding field-tested solutions back into the core platform. What you'll do: Technical Deployment & Engineering: Deploy, configure, and debug AI agents and integrations directly inside live enterprise tenant environments against complex customer workflows and real-world data. Customer Discovery & Solution Architecture: Lead technical discovery sessions with key customer stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into robust product configurations, POCs, and integration specs. Product Feedback Loop: Capture field telemetry, edge-case failures, and customer friction points to directly influence the core product roadmap and engineering backlog. Productization of Field Insights: Identify recurring deployment challenges and transform custom fixes into standardized, automated out-of-the-box product capabilities. Cross-Functional Ecosystem Alignment: Partner closely with Workday Services leads, AI Deployment Architects, and Account Teams to ensure seamless project delivery while staying focused on core product strength. Engagement Milestones & Graduation: Guide engagements through structured milestones—from kickoff to graduation—enabling self-sustaining customer ownership within standard 6-month deployment cycles. About You Basic Qualifications Experience: 7+ years in Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Consulting, or Software Development. Technical Execution: Hands-on coding and debugging skills (e.g., Python, Java, or similar) with solid understanding of REST APIs, object-oriented design, system architecture, and integration patterns. Customer Interaction: Proven experience working directly with enterprise clients on complex software deployments, live data troubleshooting, and custom workflow integration. Other Qualifications Product Mindset: Ability to abstract generalizable product requirements from bespoke customer issues. Communication: Exceptional verbal and written technical communication skills; skilled at translating complex technical challenges for non-technical leadership. Ambiguity & Agility: Thrives in fast-paced environments with evolving requirements across Product, Engineering, and Services teams. Collaboration: Highly collaborative, low-ego team player adept at working within multi-disciplinary account and delivery pods. Preferred Qualifications Applied experience with LLM-powered or agentic AI systems — e.g., prompt/context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluations, or agent orchestration frameworks — and a working understanding of how model behavior shows up as product and customer-facing issues in the field. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here . jobs.title: Senior AI Research Engineer - LLM Training & Inference Infrastructure
jobs.jd:
As a Research Engineer on the Frontier Foundations team, you will partner with Research Scientists to build the systems that run large-scale LLM training, reinforcement learning, and inference at Datadog. You will build and operate an in-house distributed runtime that schedules work across large GPU clusters, and you will own how quickly researchers can iterate and how reliably long training runs complete. 

Building on our track record of AI-powered solutions (e.g., Bits AI, Bits Evolve, and our time series foundation model Toto), Datadog AI Research (DAIR) tackles high-risk, high-reward problems grounded in real-world challenges in cloud observability and security. 

The Frontier Foundations team builds and maintains the high-performance infrastructure that lets us train and serve large language models at scale. It supports both of our research areas: 

Trained Agents for Observability -- Post-training models to operate autonomously across Datadog's domain. SRE incident response is our first target, with a clear path to code repair, security response, and infrastructure optimization. We build the simulation environments, RL training loops, and evaluation infrastructure needed to train agents that match or surpass frontier models at a fraction of the cost. 

 

What You'll Do: 

  • Design, build, and operate distributed training and inference infrastructure for large language models, including Mixture-of-Experts models 
  • Scale training with parallelism strategies (data, tensor, pipeline, and expert), memory optimization, checkpointing, and failure recovery
  • Build inference and rollout systems that support evaluation, experimentation, and RL without slowing down training
  • Build execution environments and sandboxes for online RL and agent post-training
  • Own continuous performance validation: regular benchmarks of rollout speed, training throughput, and learning behavior, with dashboards that make regressions visible 
  • Improve the researcher experience: job submission, scheduling, quotas, GPU utilization, and observability
  • Work with platform teams on cluster capacity, networking, and scheduling across GPU providers 
  • Investigate performance and reliability problems across hardware, software, and distributed systems 

 

Who You Are:

  • You have depth in distributed systems and ML infrastructure for training and inference at scale; experience with Ray, Kubernetes, Slurm, or similar frameworks is a plus
  • You are proficient in Python and in at least one systems language (e.g., Rust, C++, or Go) ● You have experience operating large-scale training or serving infrastructure, or schedulers and orchestration systems for GPU or other high-performance workloads
  • You understand what limits throughput/latency in distributed inference workloads: communication, memory, scheduling, and stragglers
  • You have strong debugging, profiling, and incident-diagnosis skills, ideally including on-call experience 
  • You can explain design and performance trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences 
  • Prior experience training machine learning models is valuable but not essential for engineers with strong distributed systems or HPC backgrounds 

 

Bonus Points (any of the following): 

  • You are familiar with distributed training frameworks such as Megatron-LM, TorchTitan, or DeepSpeed
  • You have experience with LLM inference engines such as vLLM or SGLang, including batching and KV-cache management 
  • You have experience with RL training systems and rollout infrastructure 
  • You have experience with collective communication (NCCL), RDMA, or low-latency networking

You will work at the lowest level of our stack, writing and tuning GPU kernels and removing the memory and communication bottlenecks that limit large Mixture-of-Experts models on the latest GPUs.

Building on our track record of AI-powered solutions (e.g., Bits AI, Bits Evolve, and our time series foundation model Toto), Datadog AI Research (DAIR) tackles high-risk, high-reward problems grounded in real-world challenges in cloud observability and security.

Frontier Foundations builds and maintains the high-performance infrastructure that lets us train and serve large language models at scale. It supports both of our research areas:

Trained Agents for Observability - Post-training models to operate autonomously across Datadog's domain. SRE incident response is our first target, with a clear path to code repair, security response, and infrastructure optimization. We build the simulation environments, RL training loops, and evaluation infrastructure needed to train agents that match or surpass frontier models at a fraction of the cost.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Phased Array Antenna System Validation
jobs.jd: Amazon LEO is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity. About this role We're looking for a Data Scientist to turn data from our satellite fleet into engineering decisions. Every satellite in orbit sends back a steady stream of telemetry. Every unit was also tested heavily on the ground before launch, and the ground segment watches the satellite every day while it operates. Your job is to connect these sources. You'll find out which in-orbit behaviors trace back to what we measured in the factory, which events repeat across the fleet, and which patterns point to weaknesses in the hardware design. Your findings will directly shape how we design, build, test, and operate the next generation of satellites. A typical problem starts small: a handful of satellites show a drifting temperature, an occasional link dropout, or a counter that creeps up faster than expected. You'll work out whether it's a real effect or noise, whether it's spreading, and what the affected units have in common. They might share a manufacturing lot, a configuration, an orbital environment, or a signature in their factory test history. From there you'll form a hypothesis about the physical cause and argue it in front of hardware, firmware, and reliability engineers who will push back hard. You'll also have to say plainly when the data rules your own idea out. Telemetry alone rarely settles the question, so your first stop is the ground test data we already have. Every unit in orbit has a detailed record from manufacturing and environmental testing, and the fleet as a whole is backed by an even larger population of units still on the ground. You'll dig through that history for the same behavior: did the affected units show early signs on the ground, did they sit near a test limit, does the effect appear across many units under certain conditions? Often the answer is already in data no one has looked at in this light. When it isn't, you'll design the ground experiments that can provide it. That means deciding which units to test and under what conditions, how many runs you need before the result means anything, and what outcome would confirm or refute the theory. You'll work with the engineers who run those tests, analyze the results, and close the question with a clear answer and a recommended action. Beyond individual investigations, you'll build the fleet-level view: baselines for healthy behavior, early warning indicators that catch emerging issues before they cause outages, and reliability estimates that tell us how the population is aging. You'll decide which recurring analyses should become automated monitoring and work with software engineers to make that happen. You'll be the person the team turns to when someone asks "is this normal?" about the fleet. The ideal candidate is curious about how hardware fails and comfortable with messy data from many sources. They can turn "we're seeing something odd on a few satellites" into a rigorous analysis and a clear recommendation. What you'll bring: - Master's degree or above in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, physics, electrical or aerospace engineering, or computer science, or PhD - 3/5+ years of hands-on experience in an applied or industry setting using Python and SQL to analyze large datasets such as time series, telemetry, sensor, or test data - Experience applying statistical methods (hypothesis testing, regression, time-series analysis, anomaly detection) to noisy, incomplete real-world data - Experience building visualizations and dashboards that communicate findings to engineers and decision makers - Experience framing and solving loosely defined problems, from the first question to a recommendation people act on - Ability to work with hardware and software engineers and turn their questions into analyses you can actually run Nice to have: - Experience analyzing telemetry from satellites, spacecraft, aircraft, vehicles, or other fleets of deployed hardware - Experience with reliability and failure analysis methods such as survival analysis, Weibull modeling, failure-mode analysis, and root-cause investigation - Familiarity with electronics or RF hardware, manufacturing test, environmental stress screening (thermal cycling, burn-in, HASS/HALT), or yield analysis - Experience with pattern-discovery techniques such as clustering, change-point detection, and unsupervised anomaly detection - Experience with large-scale data tools (Spark, Athena/Presto, Redshift) and AWS - Experience with visualization tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, Grafana, or Plotly/Dash - Experience working with software engineers on data pipelines: data requirements, schema design, data quality checks, and automating recurring analyses - Experience using AI-assisted tools to speed up analysis and automate repetitive work - A track record of changing engineering design or test decisions with data Export Control Requirement Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Orquestación, tool calling contra nuestros sistemas y el contexto del miembro armado desde múltiples fuentes, sobre WhatsApp y los canales que vengan. La barra de calidad. Evals sobre casos reales y criterios de aceptación definidos antes de lanzar. La plataforma. Observabilidad de LLMs (trazas, costo, latencia, calidad), evals como infraestructura, acceso a modelos agnóstico de proveedor y versionado de prompts, para que otros equipos no empiecen de cero. Seguridad en un entorno regulado. Guardrails, PII, verificación de identidad y human-in-the-loop donde el riesgo lo pide. Proyectos de punta a punta. Vas por el problema detrás del pedido, lo partes en fases y lo llevas a producción con visibilidad de riesgos y decisiones. Subir la vara. ADRs, review, pairing y patrones que otros equipos reusan. Lo que buscamos Contratamos por fundamentos, modelos mentales y patrones. El stack se aprende. Debe contar con un recorrido de al menos 5 años en el ciclo completo de desarrollo. Haber llevado LLMs en producción, con al menos un sistema frente a usuarios reales que operaste después del lanzamiento. Tool calling en serio. Diseñaste las tools y sabes qué hacer cuando el modelo llama la equivocada o con los argumentos equivocados. Evals en serio. Datasets de casos reales, LLM-as-judge calibrado contra humanos, regresiones antes de cada cambio de prompt o modelo. Datos sensibles en producción: PII, retención, acuerdos de procesamiento con proveedores. Español nativo o fluido, inglés profesional. Suma puntos Context engineering: compactación, memoria, context provisioning vía tools. Retrieval agéntico y servidores MCP, más allá de RAG sobre embeddings. Seguridad de agentes: prompt injection directa e indirecta, permisos mínimos por tool, red-teaming. Multi-agente, subagentes y ejecución durable. Costo y latencia: prompt caching, routing entre modelos, structured outputs. Evals online: shadow mode, A/B entre prompts o modelos, feedback humano que vuelve al dataset. Define procedures and tools for ongoing model quality monitoring post-deployment. Recommend best practices for handling imbalanced datasets, including evaluation of privacy-aware, LLM-based synthetic data augmentation techniques where appropriate. Select and configure orchestration tooling (e.g., MLflow, Apache Airflow, or a custom system) to establish a formal, well-documented, and reproducible re-training process that reduces reliance on manual curation or any single individual. Hands-on experience with cloud object storage (e.g., AWS S3) and evaluating relational/NoSQL database-backed alternatives. Experience with ML orchestration/automation tools such as MLflow, Apache Airflow, or comparable platforms. Familiarity with model validation techniques, including drift detection and integration/regression testing for ML models. Additional Requirements: Understanding of supervised learning workflows and Ground Truth dataset management at scale. Familiarity with privacy-conscious, LLM-based synthetic data generation approaches for addressing imbalanced datasets. Working knowledge of data quality and distribution-shift (data drift) monitoring methods. Strong documentation skills, with the ability to produce clear, reproducible technical designs and runbooks. Ability to comply with client data-handling protocols and security requirements, including when using personal equipment. - Why You Should Join Us Join us as we write a new chapter, guided by world-class leadership. If you are a Data Scientist who enjoys turning instrument data into proof of what is possible, why not join us in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, and help prove the analysis methods behind advanced semiconductor metrology systems.

We are looking for an ambitious and adaptable Data Scientist to join our new Data Science team in the Technology department, reporting to the Data Science Lead and working closely with our Modelling Scientist. You will generate and curate data, develop and test new algorithms, and benchmark them against what the instrument can physically deliver. When a method proves itself, you will package it for the Data Analysis team in Engineering, who turn it into robust product software. You will work with real customer use cases and wafer data from Applications Development, and proof-of-concept data from R&D.

We are an AI-first team, so you will use AI tools every day, while checking carefully what they produce. If your passion is speed, evidence and finding out what the data can really tell you, we’d love to hear from you.

What you’ll be doing

  • Generate synthetic data, and build and maintain the demo and performance data libraries
  • Analyse instrument data to quantify noise and limitations, and help establish the information limit, meaning what is physically extractable from the instrument
  • Develop and test new algorithms and analysis methods (for example PCA, percentile methods and machine learning) on real and synthetic data
  • Benchmark methods against the information limit: achievable performance, measurement uncertainty, gauge R&R and drift contributors
  • Write clean, reproducible prototype code with test data and expected performance, ready to hand over to Data Analysis, and build analysis tools used across the Technology department
  • Use AI tools every day to code, explore, analyse and report faster, verify what they produce, and present your results to the team

Education and experience

  • Degree or above in Physics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or a similar subject, or [2] years’ relevant experience in data science or quantitative research

Skills and experience we’re looking for:

  • Data analysis in Python (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, scikit-learn or similar)
  • Heavy, day-to-day use of AI tools in your technical work, such as coding assistants and LLMs, with the judgement to verify their outputs
  • Image or signal processing, ideally on data from scientific instruments
  • Statistics applied to measurement data: uncertainty, repeatability, noise and drift
  • Machine learning methods, and how to validate them properly
  • Clear, reproducible code and reports
  • Explaining results to technical and non-technical colleagues
  • Curious and adaptable, happy to work quickly and test ideas against the evidence

We’d love to see:

  • Atomic Force Microscopy or other nano-characterisation (SEM, FIB, profilometry), or semiconductor metrology
  • Physics-based modelling or simulation
  • Version control (Git) and C#, and experience building agentic or AI-assisted analysis workflows

Infinitesima is a privately owned company founded in 2001, as a spin-out of the University of Bristol, by CTO Professor Andrew Humphris. jobs.title: Data Scientist, Preparedness
jobs.jd: About the Team The Preparedness team is an important part of the Safety Systems https://openai.com/safety/safety-systems org at OpenAI, and is guided by OpenAI’s Preparedness Framework https://openai.com/index/updating-our-preparedness-framework/. Frontier AI models have the potential to benefit all of humanity, but also pose increasingly severe risks. To ensure that AI promotes positive change, the Preparedness team helps us prepare for the development of increasingly capable frontier AI models. This team is tasked with identifying, tracking, and preparing for catastrophic risks related to frontier AI models. The mission of the Preparedness team is to: 1. Closely monitor and predict the evolving capabilities of frontier AI systems, with an eye towards misuse risks whose impact could be catastrophic to our society 2. Ensure we have concrete procedures, infrastructure and partnerships to mitigate these risks and to safely handle the development of powerful AI systems Preparedness tightly connects capability assessment, evaluations, and internal red teaming, and mitigations for frontier models, as well as overall coordination on AGI preparedness. This is fast paced, exciting work that has far reaching importance for the company and for society. About the Role We’re hiring a Data Scientist to help build, evaluate, and continuously improve mitigations that prevent extreme harms from AI systems. This role is for an experienced, highly autonomous individual contributor who can take ambiguous problem statements, structure rigorous analyses, and translate findings into actionable product and policy changes. This position goes beyond “running evals.” You’ll help create mitigation intelligence and monitoring systems that enable OpenAI to detect issues early, measure effectiveness over time, and reduce both over-blocking (unnecessary friction) and under-blocking (missed harm). WHAT YOU’LL DO - Evaluate and improve mitigation systems, including classifiers and detection pipelines across domains (e.g., biosecurity, cybersecurity, and emerging risk areas). - Diagnose false positives and false negatives with deep error analysis, root cause investigation, and clear recommendations for mitigation adjustments. - Build monitoring and measurement frameworks to track mitigation effectiveness over time and across user segments and use cases. - Identify trends in over-blocking vs. under-blocking, quantify customer impact, and propose prioritized interventions. - Develop insights from customer feedback, complaints, and usage patterns to detect shifts in adversarial behavior and system failure modes. - Expand risk monitoring into new areas, including cybersecurity threats and model loss-of-control or sabotage scenarios, in partnership with domain experts. - Communicate results to technical and executive stakeholders with crisp narratives, decision-ready metrics, and clear tradeoffs. You might thrive in this role if you are: - An autonomous operator: you can take a problem statement and independently structure the analysis end-to-end. - Strong at executive-ready communication: concise, clear, and outcome-oriented. - Skilled in turning analysis into productable changes: you’re comfortable influencing across functions to drive mitigation improvements. QUALIFICATIONS - Significant experience in data science or applied analytics in high-stakes domains (e.g., security, trust & safety, abuse prevention, fraud, platform integrity, or reliability). - Strong foundations in experimentation, causal thinking, and/or observational inference; ability to design robust measurement under imperfect data. - Fluency in SQL and Python (or equivalent) for analysis, modeling, and building monitoring workflows. - Experience building metrics, dashboards, and operational monitoring that meaningfully changes outcomes (not just reporting). - Track record of driving cross-functional impact with engineering, product, and research partners. - Cybersecurity data science experience (strong preference), including exposure to threat modeling, adversarial dynamics, abuse patterns, or security telemetry. - Experience with classifier evaluation, calibration, thresholding, and error analysis at scale. Familiarity with detection systems in adversarial settings (e.g., evasion, distribution shift, feedback loops). - Trust & Safety experience is helpful, but not required. - Genuine interest in AI safety, alignment, and catastrophic risk prevention. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. jobs.jd: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in Netherlands. As an Applied AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems. You will develop the core infrastructure that enables AI agents to manage context, use tools, coordinate tasks, and continuously improve their performance. Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions. You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results. You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes. Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions. As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy. Accountabilities In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include: Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops. Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability. Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes. Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engineering lifecycle as fundamental practices. Develop systems and validation processes that allow agentic workflows to be thoroughly assessed before production deployment. Advance the use of large language models (LLMs) in software development by creating sophisticated AI-assisted engineering workflows. Build workflows where coding agents and specialized subagents can explore code repositories, implement changes, review architecture, validate conventions, run evaluations, and iterate with minimal human intervention. Actively use agentic engineering tools and workflows in daily development activities. Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively. Determine when to use LLMs, traditional software solutions, human intervention, or coordinated multi-agent approaches to achieve the best outcomes. Collaborate with operational and product teams to understand existing processes, identify high-value automation opportunities, and transform them into reliable production systems. Establish scalable architectural patterns and engineering standards for agentic systems as the organization grows. Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the overall direction of the AI engineering function. Requirements The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience building production-ready AI systems and the autonomy to solve complex technical challenges in a rapidly evolving environment. Practical experience building and deploying AI or agentic systems that have operated in production environments. Demonstrated understanding of real-world AI engineering challenges, including reliability, latency, context management, failure modes, evaluation, and observability. Strong knowledge of agent architectures, tool use, structured outputs, context management, orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops. Advanced practical experience with modern LLMs and the ability to build reliable workflows around probabilistic AI systems. Hands-on experience using coding agents and agentic development workflows as part of everyday software engineering. Ability to break down complex engineering tasks across multiple agents or specialized subagents and implement mechanisms for validating and improving their outputs. Strong architectural judgment and the ability to select the right combination of AI models, deterministic software, and human intervention for different challenges. High level of autonomy, ownership, and confidence making technical decisions in ambiguous situations. jobs.location: US, CA, Santa Clara US, Remote
jobs.jd: NVIDIA has helped redefine what computers can do. Now, generative AI is opening new possibilities for how people learn, create, and tackle problems. Realizing that potential means answering some of the hardest questions in AI: Where do models fall short? Which risks are we missing? How do we know our safeguards are working? As an expert in machine learning for Evaluations, you’ll help establish the evidence that guides the next generation of safer AI. Your curiosity and scientific judgment can shape what we test, what we learn, and what we build next. We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer / AI Researcher / Data Scientist to join our AI Safety and Responsibility efforts within Enterprise Risk Management. Engaging directly in engineering tasks, you will apply your data science and statistics skills. You will turn open research questions into rigorous benchmarks, inventive experiments, and tools that reveal how multimodal large language models behave under pressure. Working with researchers and platform engineers, you’ll connect those discoveries to better training methods and safeguards, with reproducible results that inform technical reviews and executive decisions. If you love asking the question no one has thought to test, and building a convincing way to answer it, come help us define what progress in AI safety looks like. What You Will Be Doing: Safety Benchmarking: Design and maintain safety benchmarks for large language and multimodal models, translating risk scenarios into test cases, datasets, and scoring rubrics. Evaluation Methodology: Define metrics and protocols that assess safety alongside model usefulness, using baselines, uncertainty estimates, and failure analysis to distinguish meaningful improvements from noise. Reproducible Evaluation: Build reusable Python pipelines with versioned datasets, model configurations, and experiment tracking to reproduce results and compare performance across model releases. Automated Red-Teaming: Develop tools to discover failure modes and expand evaluation coverage, incorporating human review to validate automated scoring and provide additional judgment. Failure Analysis: Investigate model failures with researchers, document actionable findings, and develop regression tests to assess whether model changes resolve identified issues. Results and Communication: Partner with platform engineers to store and aggregate evaluation results, and clearly communicate findings, limitations, and emerging risks to researchers and decision-makers. What We Need To See: Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, with 6+ years in the field of machine learning engineering or evaluation. Evaluation Design: Experience developing benchmarks, metrics, and statistically sound comparisons for ML systems, including selecting baselines and interpreting uncertainty. Ability to translate ambiguous evaluation questions into testable experiments. Engineering: Strong Python skills and experience building maintainable shared tools, data pipelines, and experiment-tracking workflows. Analytical Rigor: Ability to assess dataset quality, identify limitations in metrics and scoring methods, and support conclusions with reproducible evidence. Communication: Clearly explain findings and tradeoffs to researchers, engineering partners, and executives. Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd: Evaluation: Experience evaluating LLMs, multimodal models, or agentic systems through adversarial testing or automated red-teaming. Community Contributions: Contributions to public benchmarks or evaluation frameworks. Research Publications: A publication track record and interest in continuing to publish at top tier venues. Human-Aligned Evaluation: Experience validating model-based evaluators against human judgments or designing human-in-the-loop evaluation workflows. Statistical Rigor: Strong model evaluation skills and a commitment to sound statistical practices, including confidence intervals. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 9, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Platform - Moveworks
jobs.jd: The Role We're building the runtime infrastructure that powers Moveworks' AI agents — the systems that orchestrate, execute, and deliver agent responses to millions of enterprise users in real time. This role sits where large language models meet distributed systems. You'll apply machine learning, LLM, and distributed systems expertise to make agents plan, reason, and use tools reliably, and you'll build the production systems that run those agents at enterprise scale. Our AI agents can plan, execute multi-step workflows, call tools, wait on human input, and resume — all while maintaining correctness, observability, and low latency. The systems that make this possible are what you'll build and own. What you get to do in this role: Agent orchestration engine — A state machine that manages long-running agent sessions, coordinating planning, execution, and user interaction across multiple LLM calls and tool invocations Model routing and adaptation — Choose, route between, and fine-tune or distill LLMs for specific agent tasks. Meet enterprise requirements such as granular permissions, data freshness, explainability, and preserving general knowledge. Distributed session management — Lease-based ownership using conditional writes, heartbeat protocols, and crash recovery via checkpointing Event-driven message pipeline — FIFO queues for ordered delivery, consumers for event processing, and real-time streaming via gRPC and Socket.IO Structured concurrency — Running multiple concurrent tasks per session with fail-fast semantics and graceful cancellation Observability infrastructure — OpenTelemetry instrumentation, distributed trace context propagation across async boundaries, custom span lifecycle management for sessions that span minutes Caching and state layers — Redis, DynamoDB KV stores with per-org/per-bot scoping, batch read optimization, and hot-reload configuration Tool and agent connectivity for LLMs: Build MCP and agent-to-agent (A2A) capabilities, including tool discovery, namespacing, and tool selection over large tool catalogs, so the LLM picks and calls the right tool from thousands of candidates. Token efficiency and context engineering — Lower the agent's cost and latency through prompt and context discipline, caching, speculative and parallel model-call scheduling, and reducing tokens spent across multi-step LLM reasoning chains. Open-weights model adoption and evaluation — Quickly stand up newly released open-weights LLMs at different quantization levels, run them in a test environment, and benchmark their accuracy, latency and cost on agent tasks. Use the results to decide which models reach production. To be successful in this role you have: You should have deep experience in at least 3 of these areas: Distributed systems: consistency models, idempotency, exactly-once delivery, distributed locking/leasing Concurrent/async programming: Python asyncio, Go goroutines, structured concurrency, cancellation handling Event-driven architectures: message queues (SQS, Kafka), pub/sub, backpressure, delivery guarantees Database systems for infrastructure: DynamoDB (conditional writes, transactions), Redis (connection pooling, pub/sub) Observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, span context propagation, Prometheus metrics gRPC/protobuf: streaming RPCs, service interface design, error handling patterns Machine learning: Large language models, natural language processing, LLM evaluation Required: 5+ years building production backend/infrastructure systems Strong in Python or Go (ideally both) Experience designing and operating systems that handle real traffic at scale Hands-on experience building production systems that use LLMs or other ML models Comfort with ambiguity — these are novel problems without textbook solutions Relevant past experience: Building and shipping products on large language models with techniques such as RAG, chain-of-thought, self-reflection, tool and function calling, and agentic reasoning. Training, fine-tuning, or evaluating machine learning models on large datasets in production, especially for NLP, retrieval, or ranking. Improving relevance or quality through careful experimentation: designing metrics, building evaluation datasets, and developing new features and signals for ranking or model selection. Denk aan: KYC-dossiers die agents voorbereiden met herleidbare bronnen, zodat analisten sneller onderbouwd beslissen. Documenten en signalen die samenkomen voor een klachten- of schadeteam. Rapportages die nu handwerk zijn, geautomatiseerd binnen de kaders van DORA en de EU AI Act. Wat breng je mee? Aantoonbare ervaring in finance: je kent de processen, data, systemen en risico's van binnenuit. Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security. Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric. Je advies komt met een werkende versie. Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan. Het team Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak. Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen. Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen. Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen. Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt. We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief. Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen. AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen. Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen: Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent. AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken. adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken. Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties. We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.
