jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd: We're seeking a skilled Machine Learning Engineer to build and deploy production ML systems for the next-generation data management and artificial intelligence platform for maritime domain awareness. Spear AI is a growing defense contracting company dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions that support our nation's security. As we expand, we're building a culture where innovation meets mission-critical work. We operate with a flat organizational structure that empowers every team member to make an impact, collaborate directly with leadership, and contribute to projects that matter. Whether you're joining our Hardware, Software, or Services division, you'll work alongside talented professionals who are committed to excellence and advancing the capabilities that keep our nation safe and secure. Spear AI builds sonobuoy sensors that are deployed into the water and collect edge data. We also work with the U.S. Navy to collect and process their SONAR data. You'll have an opportunity to work on real-world projects that directly impact warfighter capabilities and mission success. What You'll Do We're a small team wearing many hats, and you'd have a wide variety of responsibilities that include: Design, train, and optimize machine learning models using PyTorch Deploy models to production environments in the cloud and at the edge Build and maintain ML pipelines for training, evaluation, and inference Integrate machine learning models into real-time and batch processing systems Optimize model performance for accuracy, latency, and resource constraints Implement model monitoring, versioning, and deployment strategies Work with signal processing data and time-series analysis Improve local development and CI/CD for ML workflows using modern tooling and GitHub Actions Who You Are We're looking for someone with strong Machine Learning Engineering skills who shares our most important values: You're fanatical about polish. Every detail matters. You love to make sure your code is linted, formatted, fully typed, and has comprehensive test coverage. You care about correctness. You take pride in the fact that your models perform reliably and downstream consumers trust your predictions. You obsess over performance. You daydream about model latency, throughput, and efficient inference pipelines. You dive deep. It's important for you to really know how things work. You're always building prototypes and setting up experiments to reinforce your understanding. You live on the bleeding edge. You've got a long list of upcoming ML techniques and frameworks you're excited about and can't wait to experiment with new approaches. You're a great teacher. You know how to break down complex ML concepts for a specific audience and make it click with them in a way that gets them excited. Why Work With Us We ship — We don't work on 18-month projects that are irrelevant before they're even finished. Our work has impact — We build products that are deployed to U.S. submarines and integrate with the sonobuoys we manufacture. We're growing responsibly — We have the resources to hire a lot more people, but we don't want to build a massive team of people who don't share our values. We're remote — Work from wherever you want. We collaborate in real time on Slack or asynchronously via GitHub. We're profitable — We aren't burning through cash trying to make the business work. But we also have investors who believe in us and are committed to our success. We care about doing great work — You don't need permission to sweat the details here. We don't take ourselves too seriously — We're building products that make the world safer. But we don't let that get to our heads. Important Skills Several years of experience with Python and machine learning frameworks Expertise in PyTorch for building and training neural networks Experience training and serving models in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) Proficiency with MLOps practices including experiment tracking, model versioning, and deployment Experience with model optimization for production performance and scale Knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes for containerized deployments Familiarity with REST APIs and model serving frameworks Understanding of CI/CD pipelines for ML systems Strong fundamentals in machine learning including model architecture design, training strategies, and evaluation Nice To Have Experience with reinforcement learning algorithms and applications Digital signal processing experience Background in time-series analysis or sensor data processing Experience with edge deployment and model optimization for resource-constrained environments Familiarity with distributed training across multiple GPUs/nodes Experience with model compression techniques (quantization, pruning, distillation) Contributions to open-source ML projects or research publications Experience in defense, aerospace, or other regulated industries What We Offer Unlimited PTO — Take the time you need to recharge and maintain work-life balance. Dedicated Sick Time — Your health and well-being come first. Comprehensive Health & Benefits — Medical, dental, and vision coverage to keep you and your family protected. 11 Paid Holidays — Enjoy time off throughout the year to celebrate and spend with loved ones. Professional Development — Educational opportunities and resources to help you grow your skills and advance your career. Collaborative Environment — Work directly with leadership in our flat organizational structure, where your ideas and contributions matter. Mission-Driven Work — Contribute to projects that directly support national security and make a real-world impact. Growth Opportunities — Join us during an exciting expansion phase where you can help shape our future. Additional Benefit Opportunities When You Choose Spear AI : 401(k) with company match Onsite / Remote / Flexible work arrangements or hybrid options (position dependent) Relocation assistance (position dependent) Referral bonuses Perform

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.jd:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase.

The ML & Discovery team in Consumer Growth builds the machine learning systems that help millions of customers discover what to trade and engage with next across crypto, equities, derivatives, and prediction markets. Our models and platforms power personalized feed and asset ranking, intelligent notification orchestration, and LLM-driven market insights across the Coinbase app. As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer (L5) you will own end-to-end initiatives across the ML lifecycle, from problem formulation, feature engineering, and modeling to production serving and online A/B experimentation. Partnering closely with Product, Data Science, and Engineering in a high-velocity, data-driven environment, you will shape our team's roadmap, raise our engineering quality bar, and use AI-native workflows to deliver measurable business impact.

What you’ll do: 

  • Own end-to-end machine learning initiatives from problem formulation and offline evaluation to production deployment and online A/B testing, driving measurable lifts in user engagement, retention, and trading activity.
  • Build and iterate on multi-stage recommendation, retrieval, and contextual bandit models that serve personalized experiences to millions of users across crypto, equities, derivatives, and prediction markets.
  • Design intelligent notification orchestration, candidate ranking, and targeting systems that match users with timely, high-value alerts while avoiding fatigue and improving user experience.
  • Develop production LLM pipelines, grounding workflows, and automated evaluation loops that generate accurate, real-time market insights and personalized financial content.
  • Architect resilient, low-latency model serving services and real-time feature pipelines, eliminating technical debt, leading incident response, and raising our operational reliability bar.
  • Partner with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to shape the team roadmap, mentor L3-L4 engineers, and build AI-native workflows and automation that multiply team velocity.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering and software development, with a track record of shipping production ML systems that move customer and business metrics.
  • Proven track record in one or more relevant domains: recommendation systems, multi-stage ranking and retrieval, contextual bandits, notification targeting, or production LLM applications.
  • Strong software engineering and data skills in a backend language like Python or Go, with hands-on proficiency in modern ML and data stacks (such as PyTorch, GBDTs, Spark/Databricks, Ray, Kafka, and/or Tecton).
  • Deep practical knowledge of offline model evaluation, training-serving skew mitigation, and design/interpretation of online A/B experiments tied to business metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive complex projects end-to-end, make pragmatic architectural trade-offs, and mentor junior engineers.
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.jd: About us People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. It is not. It is a large number of people acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on with tools that have barely changed in decades. Nexcade builds AI agents for those people, starting in freight forwarding, a $210BN industry. Our agents are live in production with some of the leading global forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are expanding the platform deeper into the shipment lifecycle. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality. Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We are backed by top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies. How we work Everybody codes, founders included. The whole company is technical, commercial team included, and runs on coding agents. Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate. At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work. End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it. In person, 4+ days a week in London. We value synchronous communication. Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly. Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues. The role We are building the AI platform for freight forwarding and expanding our product surface, and we are hiring software engineers across product, AI and platform to do it. You will build products that do freight forwarding work alongside our customers' teams, operating across the entire shipment lifecycle. You will work across the stack in Python, TypeScript and React, and directly with customers and founders on what gets built. Everyone here works across the stack, but each engineer has a spike: the area where they set the bar for the team. You spend most of your time where yours is, and lean on your colleagues where theirs are. Product: You build best in class products for the core jobs in freight forwarding, one job at a time. You work as a design partner with our customers to understand the work deeply, turn that understanding into a product they would choose over anything else, and feed what you learn back into the platform everyone builds on. AI: You raise the ceiling on what our AI can do and the floor on how reliably it does it. That spans high volume tasks like classification and extraction and deep workflow tasks that run for hours. You design for performance, reliability, explainability and control, set up the gyms and evals to measure them, and build the harness that runs our agents in all of our products. Platform: You own the foundation every product stands on: the runtime for thousands of concurrent agents and workflows, the way they communicate and scale, the controls for how they access data with permissions that hold, and the observability to see and measure all of it. You ensure the rest of the team can move fast without fear. What we look for A spike, with evidence. Something you have been exceptional at and proof of it. We hire on slope rather than years, so there is no experience threshold in either direction. Strong fundamentals. In the AI-assisted era, having good technical judgement is key. You have shipped production systems people depend on, seen them fail and learned from it. High agency and ownership. You take an ambiguous problem, make a call, and see it through. Humility and learning velocity. You want to get better and you change your mind when the evidence says so. Interest in the problem. You do not need a freight background, but you need to find messy real-world operations interesting rather than a chore. Why join You will shape the product, the architecture and the company, working alongside an engineering team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will work directly with the businesses using what you build, on AI applied to an industry that has resisted software for decades. You will get meaningful equity, so when this works you share in it. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Junior or Medior AI Engineer
jobs.jd: HelloPrint is rebuilding the entire platform: new frontend, new pricing engine, new content engine, new product engine, everything ready for an agentic future. No one on the team writes code manually for what these systems handle. You'll work inside this rebuild, under the direction of our founding team (Hans, CEO, and Michael, CIO/Chief AI Officer), executing on high-leverage AI problems with real commercial impact, visible immediately in revenue or cost. There's no management layer between you and the outcome. You build, you ship, you measure, you move to the next problem. What you will build: The opportunity surface is large: 14 markets, 600,000 customers, a platform being rebuilt in parallel across four core engines. You'll work on problems from areas like: Dynamic pricing and margin optimization across markets. Agentic procurement: supplier selection, ordering, quality management. Customer journey automation from configuration to post-delivery. Intelligent content and SEO infrastructure at platform scale. Predictive demand and inventory across the supplier network. Internal tooling that multiplies the output of every team. Before you read further HelloPri nt is on a mission to become the world's leading infrastructure for customizable printed products. From our offices in Rotterdam and Valencia, 100+ professionals from 20+ nationalities are building an AI-first company that scales output faster than headcount. We're at EUR 100M revenue and aiming to disrupt a trillion-dollar industry. Every hire we make needs to help get us there. Commercial instinct first, engineering second. You think about what something is worth before you think about how to build it. Full-time in Rotterdam . Five days a week, in the building where the transformation is happening. You have been building since before it was a career. Side projects, tools, systems nobody asked for. The obsession came first. You ship continuously. You ship fast and you ship real systems. Not prototypes, not demos. You are more than just an engineer. You understand product decisions, user impact, and design tradeoffs. You do not need a PM to translate the business problem for you. Who you are: You've built and shipped real production systems, not just contributed to someone else's. You're comfortable with ambiguity and don't need a fully specified brief to start. You care about what your work is worth, not just whether it works. You want to build inside a company that's already proven, not another 0-to-1 bet. You do not think of yourself as an AI engineer. You think of yourself as someone who solves hard problems and builds the systems to prove it. The engineering is the method. The obsession is the identity. Three signals that tell us you are that person: You've spotted an opportunity for an AI solution before anyone assigned it to you, and built it, even if it started as a side project or a shortcut nobody asked for. Ask you to name one and it won't take you long. What you've shipped has been in production and actually used, not a prototype sitting in a repo or a demo that impressed someone once. You can point to at least one thing you built where you had a rough idea of what it was worth before building it, and checked afterward whether it delivered. Must-haves: Hands-on production experience, not purely architectural or supervisory. Commercial instinct that precedes technical execution: you know the business case before you write the first line. Track record of shipping production AI/software systems that are live and used by real users. Solid fluency in LLMs, agentic workflows, and modern AI infrastructure. Ability to reason about commercial impact, not just technical correctness. Comfortable working with high autonomy and limited process. Office-first: on-site in Rotterdam, five days a week. This role is not for you if you: This role is not for people who got into AI because it became important. It is for people who have been building since before anyone called it a career. The kind of person who coded as a teenager, shipped their first thing before anyone asked, and has never really stopped. Who finds it genuinely difficult to explain why they build: it is just what they do. Who would rather spend a Sunday solving a hard systems problem than almost anything else. If you have to think about whether that description fits you, it probably does not. Got into AI because it became an important skill, not because you could not imagine doing anything else. Need a brief, a PM, or a defined scope before taking action. Measure your output in technical quality or feature count rather than business impact. Would answer 'what would you build first?' with an infrastructure question. If you think a workweek of 40h is a lot. Prefer hybrid or remote working. What we offer 🎯 Room to grow: opportunities develop fast, within your role and across HelloPrint 🌍 The team: 100+ people from 20+ nationalities who build at a pace most companies cannot match. Rotterdam is not a compromise. It is where the work happens. 🚀 Real impact: shape the future of a high-growth, AI-driven company where your ideas land in production the same week. 💡 Full autonomy from day one: no roadmap to follow, no brief to wait for. You see the problem, you build the solution, you own the outcome. 🏃🏻‍♂️‍➡️ Hello-Benefits: including 24/7 HelloFit gym access, UrbanSportsClub discount, the best events and company-sponsored healthy meals every day 💶 Base salary: €50,000 to €75,000 gross per year, depending on skills, level and experience. Ready to build something? We need bold thinkers, fast executors, and AI-first problem solvers. If that sounds like you, apply now. Let's redefine an industry together. At HelloPrint, we believe diversity makes us better. We're building a workplace where everyone can be themselves, grow, and do their best work regardless of background, identity, or perspective. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer - Multi-Agent Frameworks
jobs.jd: At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀 Role Overview: We are seeking a skilled and experienced Senior AI Engineer - Multi-Agent Frameworks to join our AI Platform team. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in building a cutting-edge platform that empowers our users to create and deploy sophisticated intelligent agents, with a key focus on enabling collaborative and multi-agentic behaviors . This is a backend-focused role that requires deep expertise in AI, large language models (LLMs), and orchestration software. Key Responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain a robust platform to enable users to create and manage AI agents and their interactions. Integrate and work with multiple LLMs, ensuring seamless orchestration and scalability for both individual and coordinated agent operations. Leverage orchestration frameworks like LangGraph and others to build complex workflows and pipelines that support diverse agent functionalities, including frameworks for multi-agent coordination . Develop and implement evaluation frameworks for testing AI agents in challenging and complex scenarios, focusing on individual performance and system-level dynamics. Stay at the forefront of AI advancements, incorporating the latest research and technologies into our platform to enhance agent capabilities and collaboration. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and frontend engineers, to deliver a seamless user experience for building and deploying intelligent systems. Address challenging AI privacy scenarios, ensuring compliance with data protection regulations and best practices within agent-based applications. Contribute to improving search capabilities and integrating them into the AI platform to provide agents with essential information access. Qualifications: Proven experience working with multiple LLMs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Cohere, etc.) and understanding their strengths and limitations. Expertise in orchestration software like LangGraph or similar frameworks used for building and managing agent workflows. Strong background in developing evaluation frameworks for AI systems, particularly in complex testing environments. Deep understanding of AI and machine learning fundamentals, with a focus on backend engineering. Passion for staying updated with the latest developments in AI and applying them to real-world problems, particularly in the realm of agent technologies. Experience with challenging AI privacy scenarios, including data anonymization, secure data handling, and compliance. Experience with search technologies and their integration into AI systems. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.jd: At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions. The Data Science team is responsible for leveraging our most valuable asset—our data—to generate meaningful value for our members. From building models that assist physicians in treating conditions to identifying members in need of specialized care, Data Science at Clover develops data products and insights that are central to our mission and differentiation as a company. Our impact is tremendous—as a Senior Data Scientist, you’ll help build a revolutionary healthcare company by delivering data-driven solutions that directly improve patient outcomes. As a Senior Data Scientist you will: Lead large-scale projects from ideation through enterprise impact. Apply a broad problem-solving toolkit to develop both creative and practical solutions. Evaluate trade-offs between out-of-the-box and customized solutions, optimizing for speed and effectiveness. Implement scalable, bug-free, and well-tested solutions that reduce complexity rather than add to it. Understand business challenges and deliver results that meaningfully solve key problems. jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning)
jobs.jd: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) based in Netherlands. As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems. You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures. Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges. Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents. You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks. Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment. Accountabilities In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include: Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities. Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems. Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes. Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking. Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements. Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment. Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback. Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic, real-world environments. Conduct large-scale experiments and translate empirical findings into practical algorithmic improvements. Publish and present research findings at leading international conferences, including ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV. Requirements The ideal candidate combines strong theoretical knowledge of reinforcement learning with hands-on experience developing and optimizing large-scale multimodal AI systems. The following qualifications and technical skills are expected: Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. A PhD in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, or a closely related field is preferred. Strong track record of AI research, including publications in leading international conferences. Demonstrated experience conducting large-scale reinforcement learning experiments in multimodal and vision-centric systems, including online reinforcement learning environments. Proven ability to improve domain-specific decision-making and achieve measurable gains in policy performance. Deep understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and optimization techniques applied to vision and multimodal learning. Strong knowledge of policy stability, exploration strategies, sample efficiency, and optimization in complex, high-dimensional environments involving images, video, and other modalities. Advanced proficiency in PyTorch and modern deep learning frameworks for computer vision and multimodal AI. Hands-on experience building end-to-end reinforcement learning pipelines covering simulation, model training, evaluation, and production deployment. Ability to address fundamental reinforcement learning challenges, including sample inefficiency, exploration-exploitation trade-offs, and training instability. Experience designing robust evaluation frameworks and using empirical research to continuously improve algorithmic performance. Established research publication record at top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, or ECCV. jobs.title: AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning)
jobs.jd: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) based in Switzerland. As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems. You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures. Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges. Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents. You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks. Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization. This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment. Accountabilities In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include: Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities. Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems. Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes. Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking. Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements. Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment. Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback. Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic, real-world environments. Conduct large-scale experiments and translate empirical findings into practical algorithmic improvements. Publish and present research findings at leading international conferences, including ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV. Requirements The ideal candidate combines strong theoretical knowledge of reinforcement learning with hands-on experience developing and optimizing large-scale multimodal AI systems. The following qualifications and technical skills are expected: Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. A PhD in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, or a closely related field is preferred. Strong track record of AI research, including publications in leading international conferences. Demonstrated experience conducting large-scale reinforcement learning experiments in multimodal and vision-centric systems, including online reinforcement learning environments. Proven ability to improve domain-specific decision-making and achieve measurable gains in policy performance. Deep understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and optimization techniques applied to vision and multimodal learning. Strong knowledge of policy stability, exploration strategies, sample efficiency, and optimization in complex, high-dimensional environments involving images, video, and other modalities. Advanced proficiency in PyTorch and modern deep learning frameworks for computer vision and multimodal AI. Hands-on experience building end-to-end reinforcement learning pipelines covering simulation, model training, evaluation, and production deployment. Ability to address fundamental reinforcement learning challenges, including sample inefficiency, exploration-exploitation trade-offs, and training instability. Experience designing robust evaluation frameworks and using empirical research to continuously improve algorithmic performance. jobs.title: Sr ML Engineer, Admin Central
jobs.jd: Your work days are brighter here. We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. About the Team We are hiring Sr ML Engineers across two teams. Admin Central is building the future of how administrators work across Workday—turning a fragmented patchwork of tools and disconnected AI into a single, unified experience. Within Admin Central, Workday implementations move from being driven by human effort to being powered by intelligence designed into the platform. The Business Process Optimize (BPO) team powers the underlying platform infrastructure. You’ll build mission-critical distributed systems, high-availability usage pipelines, new agentic functionality, and event-driven data flows across global product regions to ensure enterprise billing integrity at scale. If you're excited to build from scratch, move fast, and transform how thousands of admins work every day, come join us! About the Role Key Responsibilities ML Infrastructure & Pipeline Engineering: Architect, deploy, and maintain end-to-end Machine Learning pipelines—from distributed data ingestion and feature engineering to model training, evaluation, and production deployment. Agentic AI & Recommendation Engines: Design algorithms and LLM-driven recommendation features (e.g., IDD insights, next-best-action models) that optimize agentic workflows and tool usage. Low-Latency Inference & Scaling: Optimize real-time model inference and scoring microservices to ensure sub-second response times across high-concurrency multi-tenant environments. LLM & Agentic Observability: Integrate telemetry and tracing (OpenTelemetry, LangChain, LangSmith) into ML pipelines to track model performance, prompt/response drift, and execution efficiency. Data & Feature Store Architecture: Collaborate with core backend engineers to leverage big data platforms (ClickHouse, Apache Iceberg, Spark) for high-dimensional feature retrieval and analytics. Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner closely with Product Managers, Data Engineering, SRE, and Legal/Compliance to translate complex business and governance requirements into scalable ML solutions. About You Basic Qualifications 8+ years of experience in machine learning development, researching, developing, and implementing advanced machine learning models and techniques, with at least 4+ years focused explicitly on building, deploying, and operating production Machine Learning systems at scale. 5+ years of experience and proficiency in deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), and GenAI/LLM orchestration, utilizing frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, LangChain, and LlamaIndex, alongside proficiency in Java, Go, Scala, or C++ for high-performance backend systems. AI/ML Expertise: Solid knowledge of RAG architectures, LLM fine-tuning, intent classification, and recommendation engines—applying ML algorithms and Model-Based Design (including MCP tooling and structured agentic execution paths) to multi-agent orchestration, contextual reasoning, and workflow optimization. Data Analysis & Feature Engineering: Experience leading EDA on multi-tenant execution logs to validate prompt/response accuracy and optimize tool usage, paired with strong feature engineering skills for vector embeddings, feature stores, and multi-tenant data isolation. Team Collaboration: Strong ability to mentor team members, drive cross-functional technical alignment, draft system design specs/model cards, and communicate technical and governance decisions. jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist
jobs.jd: Meet the team You’ll join the Traffic Control Features team within TomTom’s Automated Driving organization . The team builds the technology that turns real-world observations into reliable map information about traffic signs, traffic lights, stop lines and road markings . You’ll work with applied scientists and software engineers to develop algorithms and machine-learning solutions that detect, position and connect these features to the right roads and driving directions. The goal is to deliver accurate, scalable map content that supports navigation and advanced driving experiences. TomTom measures these features using quality dimensions such as recall, precision, and road-relation accuracy. What you will do: Develop algorithms and ML solutions for traffic signs, traffic lights, road markings, and other traffic-control features, including projects with Computer Vision and Image Recognition. Design and productionize solutions that extract reliable map information from diverse, large-scale and noisy real-world data sources, including car sensor data and unstructured information. Improve how features are detected, positioned, and associated with the correct road/lane and driving direction. Drive measurable improvements in recall, precision, and overall map quality against customer-facing targets. Own components of production pipelines, from input data and feature extraction through evaluation and validated map output. Solve complex problems involving geospatial geometry, map matching, computer vision, image recognition, noisy observations, ground-truth quality, and large-scale evaluation. Run experiments, translate successful approaches into production solutions, and clearly document outcomes. Use AI tools, such as Claude Code, to support problem solving, data analysis, implementation, and engineering productivity. Mentor junior colleagues, provide insightful code reviews, and contribute to hiring. What you will need: 4+ years of professional experience in Applied Science, Machine Learning, algorithm development, computer vision or related field. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Geospatial Science, Statistics or another quantitative field. Master’s or PhD is a plus. Strong fundamentals in algorithms and machine learning , including model development, evaluation, statistics and experimental design. Proficiency in Python , an ML framework such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, and large-scale data processing tools such as Spark or Databricks. Experience taking algorithms, ML models or data pipelines from experimentation into production . Experience leading well-scoped technical projects and mentoring junior colleagues. Ability to work across data, algorithms, modeling, ground truth and evaluation rather than operating within only one area of expertise. Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom! Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet. Work with a team of 3,300+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. jobs.location: US, CA, Santa Clara US, CA, Remote
jobs.jd: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in an inclusive, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. Serving as an AI Engineer on our AI Safety Engineering team, you will have a key and adaptable role in scaling methods to secure and align advanced AI systems. Your early work will center on architecting and developing the fundamental elements of our safety infrastructure, emphasizing autonomous automation cycles. To operationalize these automated workflows, you will partner with Research and Model Development teams thereby delivering novel models for harm detection, content moderation, dynamic guardrails, post-training, and groundbreaking automated research pipelines that push the limits. This role is built for a tenacious builder and an inquisitive problem solver. We want an engineer who thrives in ambiguity. They must have the grit to overcome complex technical challenges and transform innovative safety concepts from raw ideas to scalable implementations. What You’ll Be Doing: Architect Agentic Automation: Compose, build, and deploy foundational agentic automation loops that streamline workflows spanning safety evaluations, red-teaming, model testing, model post-training and ablations. Develop Safety Models: Move from infrastructure automation towards training and implementing specialized systems for identifying harmful content, coordinating content quality, and run-time guard-railing. Pioneer Auto-Research: Build and guide automated research frameworks. These frameworks use LLMs and autonomous agents to discover new vulnerabilities. They also generate or augment safety datasets for benchmarking or training and propose novel alignment techniques. Scale Innovations: Take proof-of-concept safety interventions and research ideas and engineer them into robust, highly scalable solutions that integrate seamlessly into our production pipelines. Cross-Functional Execution: Partner closely with researchers, platform engineers, and data scientists to bridge the gap between theoretical AI safety research and practical, technically focused automated systems. What We Need To See: Education: Bachelor’s degree or Master’s degree with equivalent experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related field. Experience: Candidates should have a strong track record in ML engineering or software engineering with 8+ years of experience. Agentic Systems & Automation: Proven experience building complex, automated workflows using LLMs, including multi-turn tool-calling, orchestration, and autonomous agent loops. Strong engineering fundamentals include deep proficiency in one or more languages such as Rust or Python. Experience with machine learning frameworks like PyTorch is also required. The focus is on writing scalable, maintainable, and highly optimized code. Inquisitive Problem-Solving & Tenacity: A demonstrated ability to tackle open-ended, ambiguous problems. You must be willing to experiment, fail, iterate, and relentlessly pursue solutions. End-to-End Execution: The ability to own a project from the initial white-boarding of a research idea to the final deployment of a scalable production system. Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd: Safety & Security Background: Prior domain experience in Trust & Safety, cybersecurity, threat intelligence, adversarial machine learning, or content moderation. Guardrails & Moderation: Hands-on experience developing, fine-tuning, or deploying models specifically built for harm detection, content safety (violence, hate, harassment, CBRNE, etc.) filtering, or run-time AI guardrails. Auto-Research Experience: Contributions to projects that use LLMs to automate coding, data synthesis, or scientific research tasks. Community & Collaboration: Active contributions to publicly available agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, AutoGPT, Semantic Kernel) or AI safety benchmarking tools. Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/ Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are: 184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits . Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 10, 2026. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Financial Services- NYC
jobs.jd: About the team OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with banks, asset managers, insurers, and private capital firms to deploy production-grade AI systems in high-stakes financial environments. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development, embedding deeply with customers to translate frontier model capabilities into reliable, auditable systems that create measurable business impact. Our work turns early deployments into repeatable solution patterns, operating standards, and evaluation practices that scale across regulated financial institutions. About the role We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to lead end-to-end deployments of OpenAI’s models inside financial services organizations where correctness, latency, explainability, and control matter. You will work with customers who are experts in investment banking, trading, risk, compliance, underwriting, research, operations, or investment decision-making, translating complex workflows, data constraints, and regulatory requirements into production systems. You will measure success through production adoption, workflow efficiency, risk reduction, revenue impact, and evaluation-driven feedback loops that inform product, model, and GTM strategy. You’ll work closely with Product, Research, GTM, Security, Legal, and GRC to deliver systems that meet enterprise standards for governance, auditability, and operational resilience. You will also play a central role in shaping OpenAI’s Financial Services offering — identifying high-value use cases, defining solution patterns, and building the first repeatable deployments that scale across institutions. Learn more about some of our work with financial institutions https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-financial-services/. This role is based in New York. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% may be required. In this role, you will: - Design and ship production AI systems around models, owning integrations, data flows, reliability, observability, and on-call readiness across financial workflows. - Lead discovery and scoping from pre-sales through post-production, translating ambiguous business problems into hypothesis-driven problem framing, system requirements, and delivery plans with measurable outcomes. - Define and enforce launch criteria for regulated financial environments, including controls, audit artifacts, evaluation benchmarks, and acceptance thresholds tied to risk and performance. - Build in sensitive data environments where access controls, data lineage, explainability, and failure modes shape architecture and operating procedures. - Run evaluation loops that measure model and system quality against workflow-specific financial benchmarks (e.g., accuracy, latency, coverage, false positives) and use results to drive iteration. - Own delivery state across multiple workstreams, making trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality to protect production outcomes. - Distill deployment learnings into hardened primitives, reference architectures, playbooks, and tooling that scale across financial institutions. - Surface field feedback that informs model behavior, product capabilities, and platform gaps in real-world financial use cases. You might thrive in this role if you: - Bring 5+ years of software engineering, ML engineering, or technical deployment experience with customer-facing ownership in financial services or adjacent regulated industries. - Have owned complex AI or data-driven systems end-to-end, from scoping through production adoption, in environments where errors carry real financial or regulatory consequences. - Have experience with financial workflows such as research, trading, risk, compliance, underwriting, operations, or investment processes, and understand how incentives and controls shape adoption. - Write and review production-grade code across backend and frontend systems using Python, JavaScript, or comparable stacks. - Have deployed systems powered by LLMs or generative models and understand how model behavior, evaluation, and guardrails affect user trust and business outcomes. - Communicate clearly across engineering, product, risk, compliance, and executive stakeholders, translating technical trade-offs into decision quality and risk posture. - Apply systems thinking with high execution standards, turning incidents, escalations, and failures into improved operating standards and repeatable deployment patterns. - Stay calm and decisive when delivery is urgent, ambiguous, and high-stakes. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), Cyber - NYC
jobs.jd: About the team OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team builds with customers to bring frontier AI into production. Our Cyber FDEs partner with the security and engineering teams that defend globally critical systems, from enterprise software to the core infrastructure it runs on. Cyber FDEs work closely with our Product, Research, and Go-to-Market teams to adapt our products and models to what customers need to defend their systems. About the role You’ll build systems that give defenders an advantage at a scale few engineering teams encounter. You might help an enterprise identify, test, and deploy patches across hundreds of thousands of code repositories, or help a security team analyze petabytes of logs for signs of malicious agents or coordinated attacks. Across these deployments, you’ll build tools that customer engineers can trust to support consequential security decisions. You’ll work directly with customer security teams, from CISOs to frontline analysts. As AI changes how attackers operate, you’ll help these teams determine where their defenses need to evolve, prioritize what to build, and validate solutions with the engineers who will operate them. Alongside OpenAI’s account teams, you’ll translate security priorities into deployed systems that help defenders cover more ground. You’ll also help shape what OpenAI builds next. When you identify a gap between what defenders need and what today’s models or products can do, you’ll partner with Research and Product to define, build, and test capabilities that address it. This role is based in New York. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required. In this role you will: - Partner with customer security leaders and OpenAI’s Go-to-Market team to scope engagements, establish responsibilities, and define measurable success criteria. - Lead technical design and implementation alongside customer engineers. Integrate agents into security workflows, establish access boundaries, and determine which actions require human review. - Build evaluations grounded in the decisions defenders make. For a patching agent, test whether a fix blocks a known exploit while preserving expected application behavior. For a detection system, replay historical attacks alongside normal traffic to measure detection speed and false-positive rates. - Guide production rollout with the engineers who will operate the system. Provide the observability and controls they need to understand system behavior, intervene when necessary, and expand adoption with confidence. - Translate successful approaches across deployments into reusable tools and engineering practices that other defenders can adopt. You might thrive in this role if you: - 5+ years of software engineering experience, including building and shipping production software. - Experience protecting production systems through work in security engineering, infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or product engineering. - Experience building and evaluating AI agents for software engineering workflows. - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and practices that maintain code quality, reliability, and security. - Ability to navigate unfamiliar codebases and contribute maintainable, production-quality changes. - Ability to communicate technical concepts and trade-offs to engineering teams and senior security stakeholders. Additional experience Cybersecurity spans many disciplines, and while we’re primarily looking for strong engineering generalists, we’d love to hear about deeper experience in any of the following areas: - Security curiosity and experimentation: You read CVE write-ups because you want to understand how things break. You may have built an agent honeypot to test a hypothesis—or prove a point—and enjoy turning a security question into a hands-on experiment. - Security community engagement: You enjoy exchanging ideas with defenders, whether that’s discussing security strategy with a CISO at Black Hat or comparing technical approaches with frontline practitioners. - Application security: You’ve written CodeQL queries or Semgrep rules, built fuzzing harnesses, or discovered and responsibly disclosed vulnerabilities. - Automated remediation: CI/CD is your happy place. You’ve built tooling that turns security findings into tested patches, dependency upgrades, or configuration changes across large codebases. - Detection engineering: You’ve written and deployed detections using Sigma, YARA, Splunk, or KQL and tested them against attacker behavior. - Cloud and identity security: You’ve designed cloud IAM architectures and investigated abuse of workload identities, role hierarchies, or cross-account trust. - Security research: You’ve reverse-engineered malware, developed exploit reproductions, or contributed to vulnerability research. - Agent security: You’ve tested agents for prompt injection, tool misuse, or credential exposure and built defenses against them. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development, converting early deployments into repeatable system standards and evaluation practices that scale across regulated environments. About the Role We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to push the frontier on what is possible today across drug discovery (e.g., target identification, molecular design, pre-clinical) and development (e.g., trial design, trial ops, biostats) by leading end-to-end deployments of our models inside life sciences organizations and research institutions. You will work with customers who are deep experts in their scientific or operational domains, translating real-world data, infrastructure, and constraints into production systems. You will measure success through production adoption, measurable workflow impact, and eval-driven feedback loops, including evaluation benchmarks and acceptance criteria, that inform product and model roadmaps. You’ll work closely with our Product, Research, Partnerships, GRC, Security, and GTM to deliver in regulated contexts, including inspection readiness with audit trails and traceable evidence. This role is based in New York. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.jd: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Engineer based in Netherlands. We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to build and deploy production-grade AI systems that address complex challenges across heavy industries, including utilities, manufacturing, logistics, and energy. You will play a key role in developing a next-generation industrial operating system, taking innovative products from concept to production. The role combines agentic AI, multimodal machine learning, industrial data integration, and full-stack engineering. You will work with real-world data from sensors, machines, and operational systems to deliver intelligent solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and decision-making. This is a high-ownership opportunity in a fast-moving, zero-to-one product environment. You will help establish the foundations of an ambitious platform designed to transform industrial operations. Accountabilities You will design, build, and ship the core AI capabilities of an industrial intelligence platform, connecting advanced models with operational data, enterprise systems, and practical decision-making tools. Develop and deploy agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tool use, state management, and human-in-the-loop workflows. Build agent runtimes and orchestration frameworks supporting specialized agents for vision quality, predictive maintenance, and operations planning. Design context assembly systems using industrial ontologies and memory, including tool dispatch, approval gates, tracing, and cost controls. Develop multimodal data pipelines combining video processing, computer vision, and structured operational data. Implement computer vision capabilities such as object detection, segmentation, and action recognition, using technologies such as YOLO and OpenCV. Process industrial sensor data, including RTSP video, time-series telemetry, vibration, thermal data, and PLC/OPC-UA streams. Build signal-processing and sensor-correlation workflows, including FFT feature extraction and cross-sensor analysis. Design and contribute to industrial ontologies and knowledge graphs representing plants, assets, sensors, work orders, materials, and maintenance histories. Develop memory systems for trace storage, playbooks, asset templates, and reusable failure-pattern libraries. Build operational interfaces such as dashboards, evidence-based alerting workflows, replanning tools, and audit trails. Develop integration connectors for ERP, CMMS, WMS, industrial historians, and PLC systems, ensuring data normalization and consistent schema mapping. Deliver end-to-end solutions spanning data ingestion, model serving, backend services, and frontend interfaces. Ensure production systems meet demanding requirements for reliability, latency, scalability, cost efficiency, and operational usability. Requirements The ideal candidate is an autonomous, hands-on AI engineer with experience taking complex systems from initial development to production, particularly in environments involving physical-world data and industrial operations. At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production AI systems; 5+ years preferred. Proven experience developing agentic AI products and production systems, including orchestration, tool integration, state management, and human oversight. Experience as an early-stage engineer at a venture-backed startup, contributing to products and systems from zero to one. Strong background in AI and machine learning applied to physical-world systems. Experience working with large-scale industrial data, such as video streams, IoT devices, sensor telemetry, vibration, thermal data, or PLC/OPC-UA systems. Hands-on experience building multimodal AI pipelines that combine computer vision with structured operational data. Understanding of data ingestion, normalization, temporal alignment, data quality, and ground-truth challenges in real-world environments. Experience with industrial ontologies, knowledge graphs, or structured context systems based on asset hierarchies and operational processes. Experience integrating AI systems with enterprise and industrial platforms such as ERP, CMMS, WMS, historians, or PLC systems. Strong software engineering skills across backend and frontend development, including Python and TypeScript. Experience with production-oriented technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React Native, and OpenCV. A practical understanding of system reliability, failure modes, latency, cost management, and human interaction. Ability to work autonomously, take ownership, and deliver in a fast-paced, high-intensity environment. Strong motivation to solve complex industrial challenges through hands-on engineering and applied AI. Benefits Opportunity to help build a category-defining industrial operating system with the potential to shape manufacturing plants and industrial facilities over the next 10–20 years. Exceptional employee equity package, with an equity pool described as twice the industry standard and an estimated value of more than $200,000 from day one. Opportunity to work alongside an experienced team with backgrounds in enterprise technology, industrial robotics, autonomous driving, and academic research. Exposure to complex, real-world industrial challenges and large volumes of underutilized sensor data. Direct impact on operational efficiency, predictive maintenance, industrial reliability, and decision-making across major industries. Opportunity to contribute to a zero-to-one product in an ambitious, innovation-driven environment. jobs.jd: We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer for our Autonomous Vehicles Data Curation team. The role involves applying state-of-the-art techniques to search, curate, and evaluate high-quality datasets and ground truth for autonomous vehicles, a critical aspect of our next-generation products. You will have the opportunity to work with top researchers and engineers in the field of deep learning and computer vision to deliver impact to our customers around the world. Intelligent machines powered by Artificial Intelligence computers that can learn, reason and interact with people are no longer science fiction. Today, a self-driving car powered by AI can meander through a country road at night and find its way. An AI-powered robot can learn motor skills through trial and error. The era of AI has begun. NVIDIA's GPUs run Deep Learning algorithms, simulating human intelligence, and act as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Just as human imagination and intelligence are linked, computer graphics and AI come together in our architecture. NVIDIA GPUs are used broadly for Deep Learning, and NVIDIA is increasingly known as “the AI company”. Make your choice to join us today. We are training Deep Neural Networks and developing data search and curation capabilities for NVIDIA's Autonomous Vehicles effort, with the goal to enable autonomous driving. We are seeking Deep Learning/Machine Learning engineers who are passionate about building the datasets and tools that support perception, prediction, planning and control for self-driving cars to achieve full autonomy. Are you interested in applying AI to discover and understand challenging driving scenarios at scale? If so, join us! What you'll be doing: Stay up to date with the latest research and innovations in deep learning, implement and experiment with new ideas. Foster collaborative partnerships with our researchers and engineers, transforming innovative research into robust, industrial-strength machine learning models. Taking approaches from initial evaluation and experimentation all the way to shipping. Defining, collecting, and curating training and evaluation datasets, with a focus on scenario coverage and label quality. Developing vision-language models and embeddings for scenario search, classification, and automated data curation. Building training pipelines and scalable inference systems (PyTorch, TensorFlow, TensorRT, Python, C++). Proven experience building robust software. Passionate about Artificial Intelligence for robotics and autonomous navigation Strive to learn new things and like solving hard problems Math knowledge Experience in Deep Learning / Machine Learning. You have a background in Computer Vision and/or multimodal learning. Programming and debugging skills in C++ and/or Python. Good communication and analytical skills. Ability to work with multiple teams in a dynamic environment. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lead
jobs.jd: TL;DR – We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineering Lead to help scale the future of AI-powered software creation. You'll build and lead the FDE team and partner with our most ambitious customers to turn ideas into real products. This is still a hands-on role: you'll design, write, and ship production code alongside your team, while partnering with our other FDE leaders to shape how the function operates globally. It's a unique opportunity to scale a new discipline from scratch and solve problems that no one has solved before. Why Lovable? Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we're just getting started. We're building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world. Lovable is one of TIME's 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software. About the role Most engineering leadership roles move you away from the code. This one keeps you close to the craft and the customer. You'll build, develop, and lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers who partner with our customers at the frontier of what Lovable can do, solving hard technical problems across our frontend, backend and AI systems. The goal isn't just to make individual deployments succeed. It's to spot what should become part of the Lovable platform and act on it. As one of a small group of FDE leaders, you'll set the technical bar for the function and help define how it scales, from its engineering standards and ways of working to how it works with customers and our core product teams. If you want to build an exceptional engineering team without stepping away from building yourself, this is that role. What we're looking for - 12+ years across software engineering, technical architecture, and customer-facing engineering - Experience leading and developing high-performing technical teams - A track record of remaining deeply hands-on as your leadership scope has grown - Strong full-stack engineering fundamentals, including React and TypeScript on the frontend and robust backend development - Strong architectural thinking and familiarity with distributed systems - Experience owning complex technical engagements end-to-end - Exceptional product intuition and ability to work directly with users - Ability to move comfortably between writing code, making architectural decisions, leading engineers, and working with senior stakeholders - Comfort operating with high ambiguity, agency, and velocity Bonus if you've: - Scaled a team or technical function from zero - Worked on agentic AI systems or built with LLMs in production - Led zero-to-one product development - Worked in a founding or early startup environment - Worked across high-growth startups, big tech, consulting, or enterprise AI What you'll do - Build, develop, and lead a team of Forward Deployed Engineers - Work directly with customers to understand their workflows, needs, and hardest technical problems - Design, prototype, and implement solutions alongside your team - Own and guide projects end-to-end, from discovery and architecture through shipping and iteration - Set the technical bar through architecture decisions, code reviews, and hands-on engineering - Translate insights from customer deployments into foundational platform improvements - Partner with other FDE leads to shape the function's engineering standards, rituals, and playbooks as it scales globally - Contribute to core product strategy, technical decisions, and cultural foundations Our Tech Stack - Backend: Golang & Rust - Frontend: React, TypeScript - Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers - Tooling: GitHub Actions, OTEL, Grafana, Terraform, and more About your application - Please submit your application in English - it's our company language - We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested please apply through our careers portal
