PLEASE NOTE:
Due to federal contract requirements and client site access obligations, eligibility for a U.S. government Public Trust, Secret and/or Top Secret clearance are required to access classified information. Candidates with the interest and eligibility to obtain an active Public Trust or higher clearance are strongly encouraged to apply. 

This role requires 25% travel to client sites.

About Databricks

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers, and customer obsessed, we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started.

The Role

As a Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you will work with federal, state, and local government customers to build and productionize solutions to their data & AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data. 

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

The impact you will have:

  • Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration
  • Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational big data projects including end-to-end design, build and deployment of industry-leading big data and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer
  • Empower Customers: Guide customers on architecture and design; bootstrap or implement customer projects which leads to a customers' successful understanding, evaluation and adoption of Databricks.
  • Own the Architecture: Lead architecture and design decisions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Databricks best practices.
  • Deliver Technical Components: Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs
  • Cross-Collaborate: Work with Engineers and Customer Support to provide product and implementation feedback and to guide rapid resolution for engagement specific product and support issues
  • Customer Immersion: Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.
  • Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.

What We're Looking For

        Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering
  • Fluency in writing code in Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks
  • Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one
  • Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals
  • Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Enterprise - Healthcare Life Sciences (HLS)
jobs.jd: ABOUT THE TEAM Across industries, OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering (AIE) team helps organizations turn frontier AI into safe, reliable production systems that deliver meaningful business outcomes. We work directly with customers’ engineering, product, security, and transformation teams to navigate complex architectures, data environments, governance requirements, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better OpenAI products and reusable patterns that help customers move faster. ABOUT THE ROLE As an Enterprise AIE, you will serve as a technical partner to leading organizations within the Healthcare and Life Sciences segment (HLS), helping them turn ambitious AI use cases into durable production systems and adoption at scale. You will combine deep technical judgment with hands-on engineering to provide technical leadership on complex customer deployments. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions about model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. You will work across clinical, operational, administrative and research workflows, translating security, privacy and governance requirements into practical deployment decisions. Success is measured by durable production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful business impact. Your deployment experience will also directly influence how OpenAI’s products evolve. This role may be based in one of our offices in New York City or San Francisco, or it may be performed remotely. Office-based employees follow a hybrid work model with three days per week in the office. We offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL - Work hands-on in code to design, build, evaluate, and deploy AI systems from prototype to reliable production and scaled adoption that solve important customer problems and deliver measurable business outcomes. - Partner with enterprise customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and success criteria. - Make sound technical decisions across model selection, agent and tool design, retrieval, context design, data pipelines, evaluation, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance. - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers to resolution. - Partner closely with customers’ engineering teams and OpenAI’s Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and Go-to-Market teams to turn deployment experience into actionable product feedback. - Partner with customer security, privacy, clinical and business teams to design responsible AI deployments, including data handling, access controls, evaluation, human oversight and monitoring. - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU - Have personally designed, built, and shipped AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, taking them from prototype to production and making substantial contributions through coding, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or production engineering. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting. - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working end to end across model APIs, agent and tool development, retrieval and data pipelines, evaluation, observability, integrations, and production operations. Experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable. - Know how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, automated graders, production signals, and human judgment. - Have navigated enterprise production requirements, including integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost. - Have experience delivering AI or software in healthcare, life sciences or similarly complex regulated enterprises, with measurable outcomes beyond a proof of concept and familiarity with sensitive data, legacy systems and interoperability. - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes. - Communicate clearly and credibly with hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security and product teams, and executives. - Take end-to-end ownership, exercise strong technical judgment, and move effectively through ambiguity. - Healthcare or life sciences experience is strongly preferred; strong candidates from other regulated enterprise environments are also encouraged to apply. - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility. Prior OpenAI product experience is not required. jobs.title: Development Engineer - Machine Learning  (f/m/div.)
jobs.jd: Your contribution to something big: You will contribute to an industrial research project focused on the development and optimization of heat pump systems. You will combine machine learning, data analysis, modelling, and experimental testing to develop predictive models based on experimental and field data, supporting the characterization and optimization of key parameters of the heat pump refrigeration cycle. Your main responsibilities will be: Machine Learning Development: Develop, evaluate, and improve machine learning models using experimental and field data from heat pump systems. Data Analysis & Modelling: Analyse data, model and simulate dynamic systems, and develop numerical approaches to address complex engineering problems. Heat Pump Optimization: Support the development and optimization of refrigeration cycles and heat pump systems using data-driven and model-based approaches. Predictive Models: Apply data-based methods to improve model-based concepts and support the analysis and optimization of constrained linear and nonlinear systems. Experimental Testing & Data Acquisition: Define and prepare experimental data acquisition systems, conduct tests, and analyse the resulting data to support model development and engineering decisions. Test Planning: Define and prepare structured test plans to generate high-quality experimental data for predictive model development and improvement. Field Data Analysis: Use available field data to analyse heat pump performance and support the optimization of control parameters. Machine Learning Assessment: Investigate the benefits, limitations, and risks of machine learning models, including their potential to reduce testing effort and support heat pump development. What distinguishes you: Education: University degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a comparable technical field. Machine Learning: Good understanding of machine learning models and data-driven engineering methods, with the ability to apply them to engineering problems. Programming: Good programming skills in Python and/or MATLAB for data analysis, modelling, simulation, or machine learning applications. Modelling & Simulation: Understanding of dynamic systems, numerical modelling, and simulation, with the ability to analyse complex engineering problems using model-based and data-driven approaches. Data Analysis: Experience working with experimental and/or field data, including data processing, analysis, and interpretation. Testing & Experimentation: Understanding of testing methodologies and data acquisition, with the ability to prepare test plans and support experimental activities. Digital Tools: Good knowledge of Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and OneNote. Experience with MATLAB and/or Simulink in engineering or laboratory environments. Problem Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a results-oriented mindset and attention to detail. Working Style: Proactive and responsible, with the ability to independently organize your work, take ownership of assigned activities, and propose solutions. Teamwork & Communication: Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative and Agile environment. Languages: Excellent written and spoken English. Work #LikeABosch includes: ⚖️ Flexible work conditions 🔀 Hybrid work system 🌐 Exchange with colleagues around the world 🧑‍⚕️ Health insurance and medical office on site (general surgeon, psychology, physiotherapy, general clinic) 📚 Training opportunities (p.e., technical training, foreign languages training) & certifications 📈 Opportunities for career progression and continuous professional development 💲 Access to great discounts in partnerships and Bosch products 🏋️ Sports and health related activities 💰 Flexible benefits platform 🅿️ Free parking lot 🍽️ Canteen Success stories don´t just happen. jobs.title: AI Engineer l Young Talent Program
jobs.jd: The rules of building are being rewritten. Come write them with us. Every few decades, the way companies are built gets reinvented from scratch. That is happening right now, and the people who learn to build in this new world first will define the next twenty years. Superstars are being made this year, not in ten. HelloPrint is a €100M+ e-commerce company serving businesses across Europe and the US. We are rebuilding the entire company as AI-first: our platform, customer service, operations, and how we design, price, sell, and deliver. Every piece of technology we run is being rewritten as we speak. We are doing it with a small, senior, very fast AI development team working shoulder to shoulder with our business leads. Now we are opening a handful of seats for young builders who want to grow faster than any graduate scheme, bootcamp, or big-tech ladder could ever let them. We don't care if you are 16, 25 or 30, whether you are self-taught, hacking in high school, or finishing a degree at TU Delft or TU/e—we care about what you have built and how fast you solve hard problems. The HelloPrint AI Residency is how you start. It is a permanent role from day one: your first year is a structured residency where you rotate across our most important AI projects, build alongside the team and learn at full speed. After that, you keep growing - in the direction where you have the most impact. What you will actually do: You will not get a training plan, a sandbox project or six months of shadowing. From week one, you build real things that real customers and colleagues use, on the projects that matter most to the company. You sit next to the founders, next to the engineers who are rebuilding our platform, and next to the business leads who own the outcomes. You get a lot of freedom and real responsibility, plus honest, direct guidance and feedback from people who have built this before. The kind of work you could be on in your first months: Agentic Commerce : making HelloPrint discoverable and orderable through AI assistants, so a customer can order business cards from inside a chat. AI Design Studio : letting customers create a print-ready design from a single sentence. AI-first customer service : replacing classic ticketing with agents that resolve questions, check artwork and handle orders end to end. Internal agent swarms : automating finance, purchasing, pricing and operations work that today still takes people hours. Whatever you spot next : if you see something we should build, you pitch it, and if it is good, you build it. We work with almost every modern framework and model, and we change our tools the moment something better appears. You will ship, measure, throw away and ship again - every week. Who you are: You are a builder before anything else . You have shipped things nobody asked you to build: an app, an agent, a bot, a tool your friends actually use, a side business, an open-source contribution, a weird experiment that taught you something. You probably have more GitHub commits, demos or deployed projects than most people twice your age. You are extremely curious and extremely critical. You read the new model release the day it drops and try it that evening. You question every assumption, including ours, and you can explain why. You are never satisfied with "it works" — you want to know why it works, and how it could be ten times better. You want to get better every single day, and you treat feedback as fuel rather than criticism. You take ownership: when something breaks, you fix it; when something is unclear, you go and find out. You have a solid grasp of backend and software fundamentals (Python, APIs, databases) or the raw learning capacity to pick them up in weeks. You will probably recognise yourself in most of this: You build with AI every day: Claude, Cursor, Lovable, agents, APIs, whatever gets you there fastest. You can show us concrete proof of work, not just tell us about it. You move fast without being sloppy, and you care about the details the customer sees. You are comfortable not knowing the answer, and you find it quickly. You communicate clearly in English, in writing and out loud. What we do not require: a degree, a minimum age, years of experience or a perfect CV. If you are still in school or university, we will make it work around that. What you get: The honest pitch: you will learn more here in one year than in five years almost anywhere else , because you will be building real systems for a real company that is reinventing itself, with the people who are leading that change. A contract from day one. The Residency is your first year at HelloPrint, not a trial period or an internship. Direct access to the founders and to a senior AI development team who review your work and push you. Ownership from day one : your name on projects that change how a €100M+ company runs. The best tools, no budget debates : the newest models, coding agents and frameworks, as soon as they are worth using. A growth path that follows your output, not your age : if you outgrow your role in six months, your role grows with you. A fast, flat, no-politics team in Rotterdam, with a hands-on culture and a high bar. Flexible set-up : full-time, or part-time alongside your studies. We care about what you deliver. Salary and contract are tailored to your situation and your level, and we pay properly for real talent. How to apply: Skip the cover letter. Show us what you have built. Send us three things: Your best project : a link to something you built: a live product, a repo, a demo video. Tell us in a few sentences what it does and what you would do differently now. Something you think is broken : one thing about HelloPrint (our website, our ordering flow, anything) that you would rebuild with AI, and how you would do it. A short intro : who you are and what you are obsessed with right now. Five sentences is plenty. What happens next: We read every application ourselves and reply within 5 days

jobs.title: Data Scientist (m/w/d)
jobs.jd: Make impact. Be human. Stay curious. Who we are Founded in 2006, Rewire is an applied AI company helping organizations reinvent how they work with data and AI. We partner with leading organizations across industries to create scalable business impact by solving complex challenges through data, AI, and technology. Our team of 100+ data scientists, engineers, and change agents operates across Europe from offices in the Netherlands and Germany. Strategic in intent and pragmatic in execution, we combine deep Data & AI expertise with close, committed collaboration. Collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning are at the heart of our culture. Through topic communities, expert colleagues, and our internal academy, GAIN, you'll have plenty of opportunities to develop your skills in areas such as Agentic AI, Data Strategy, AI Product Development, and Technology Platforms, while helping clients achieve measurable results. Join a team that loves learning, solving challenges together, and having fun along the way. Ready to join the ride? Where you’ll make a difference Drive data & AI projects forward – analyze data, build models, and deliver insights that create real business impact Apply cutting-edge machine learning techniques – solve complex, real-world problems with innovative approaches Develop algorithmic solutions – take ownership of your work and help transform high-impact business processes Contribute to organizational change – implement data & AI innovations supported by GAIN®, our certified education and training portfolio Use technical expertise and communication skills – build scalable data & AI solutions that drive value across the organization Collaborate with cross-functional teams – contribute from day one while learning from experienced leaders What makes us the right choice for you Be part of groundbreaking change as we scale a business in a fast-evolving industry with a dedicated international growth strategy, a team of experts, and the support of an experienced investor Step into a role where you contribute ideas, support innovation, and help shape how organizations use data & AI to create real impact Deepen your skills in data & AI – gain exposure to diverse industries, tackle real-world challenges, and grow through hands-on projects and expert mentorship in a future-focused environment Join a vibrant, multidisciplinary team that’s ambitious, collaborative, and just the right amount of nerdy – where learning and laughter go hand in hand Work alongside clients as a valued team member – building relationships based on trust, shared goals, and face-to-face collaboration whenever it matters most Thrive in a culture that values autonomy, curiosity, and bold thinking – where your voice matters, ideas turn into action, and your impact is genuinely recognized and rewarded What makes you shine You’re a motivated problem solver and a curious learner – with a passion for turning data & AI into real business impact. You’ll thrive with us if you bring: A Master’s degree with excellent results in a quantitative or STEM field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics) Practical experience through internships, projects, or research – demonstrating your ability to work with data, build models, and extract actionable insights A hands-on, growth mindset – you take ownership of your tasks, embrace challenges, and contribute to solutions that create real value Strong communication skills and a collaborative spirit – you enjoy working in teams, explaining technical concepts clearly, and supporting a positive, inclusive work environment Sharp analytical and technical skills – you excel at both problem-solving and implementing solutions that bridge business and technology Fluency in both English and German (written and spoken), and willingness to travel regularly to client sites If you're hesitating because you don't meet every requirement, don't let that hold you back. Strong candidates often underestimate how well they fit a role. If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to apply! Where you’ll work Many projects require working onsite at client locations throughout Germany (and occasionally Europe) for several days per week . Travel requirements vary depending on the project and client needs . While our main office is located in Heidelberg, many of our team members are based across various cities in Germany. This reflects our flexible and distributed team structure, which means that relocation is not required. At the same time, as we continue to grow our Heidelberg office, being located within reasonable travel distance is an advantage and helps facilitate collaboration. In their own words “At Rewire, I have the opportunity to learn how to translate my theoretical knowledge into impactful applications across multiple industries and purposes. It is always exciting to engage in stimulating conversations with my colleagues and gain exposure to different analytical perspectives on how to tackle the same problem!” – Alex Lucchini, Data Scientist at Rewire Sound like your kind of team? jobs.title: Data Scientist Geostatistiek en Bodemdata (Freelance)
jobs.jd: 📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden In deze rol ondersteun je de beleidsafdeling bij het uitvoeren en verfijnen van statistische analyses op bodemdata. Je werkt onder meer aan de volgende onderwerpen: Vlaams bodemkoolstofmonitoringsnetwerk Het Vlaamse bodemkoolstofmonitoringsnetwerk werd in juli 2021 opgestart. Over een periode van 10 jaar worden bodems onder alle landgebruiken bemonsterd, waaronder bodems in waterrijke gebieden, (half-)natuurlijke graslanden en bodems die worden beheerd door overheden, lokale besturen en burgers. Na drie werkjaren is veel data beschikbaar voor verdere statistische analyse. De resultaten moeten op termijn bruikbaar zijn voor LULUCF-rapporteringen en prognoses. Zo kunnen ze helpen onderbouwen of landbouwbodems of bodems in residentieel gebied koolstof opslaan of verliezen. Daarnaast brengen de analyses verbanden tussen verschillende bodemeigenschappen verder in kaart. Digital Soil Mapping Het monitoringnetwerk genereert puntdata over Vlaanderen. Om die data gebiedsdekkend te maken, combineer je puntdata met gebiedsdekkende predictoren via digital soil mapping en random forest. Een historische bodemdataset werd eerder op dezelfde manier verwerkt. Het is de bedoeling om die doorrekening te optimaliseren en af te stemmen op de verwerking van de monitoringdata. Europese Soil Monitoring Law De Europese Soil Monitoring Law is momenteel in onderhandeling. Als de wet wordt aangenomen, moet Vlaanderen verschillende aspecten van de monitoring van bodemdata statistisch uitklaren. Het gaat onder meer om het aantal monitoringplots, verbanden tussen verschillende methodes en de nauwkeurigheid, betrouwbaarheid en accuraatheid van de monitoring. Ook moeten monitoringseenheden worden uitgewerkt. Indicatoren en rapportering Je berekent indicatoren voor de opvolging van het Vlaamse bodembeleid en voor de voorbereiding van rapportering over de Europese Soil Monitoring Law. Je past bestaande methodieken toe, stuurt ze bij en werkt nieuwe methodieken uit in samenwerking met beleidsmedewerkers. Daarbij gebruik je statistische analyses, geostatistiek, datakwaliteitscontrole en machine learning. Je optimaliseert ook berekeningsmethoden. 📝 Jouw profiel Ervaring met het optimaliseren en tunen van databases en queries. Ervaring met digital soil mapping. Ervaring met het analyseren van datastromen. Ervaring met R. Ervaring met de publieke sector. Ervaring met databanken, in het bijzonder SQL en Oracle. Kennis van geostatistiek. Ervaring met machine learning. Ervaring met rapportering. Ervaring met scripting in Shell, Perl en Python. Vertrouwdheid met het domein bodem. ⚠️ Deze functie wordt aangeboden als een deeltijdse freelance rol (50%). Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Mechanical Forward Deployed Engineer - Switzerland
jobs.jd:
About CoLab

At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster.

Proudly based in St. John’s, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018. Since then we’ve raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250+.

About the Role

This is a high-impact role that helps define how CoLab delivers technical value to its most strategic customers in Aerospace and Defence. CoLab is a category-creating product, which means adoption isn't just a rollout. It's a change in how the organization works.

In this role, you'd act as a trusted advisor, leveraging people, process, and technology to help teams rethink how they manage feedback, data, and decision-making across design and PLM. That means getting deep into customer workflows, testing new ways of working, and building repeatable methods the rest of the team can scale.

You'll work alongside a Customer Success Manager, and use what you learn on the front line to help shape product direction. This role isn't about selling or pitching. It's about deeply understanding engineering problems and solving them alongside the customer.

We are looking for a candidate in Switzerland to work regularly on-site with local CoLab customers.

Our Ideal Candidate

You’re a mechanical engineer by trade and have worked as a designer in an A&D company. You also understand the full product development life cycle: how design, manufacturing, quality, and engineering leadership depend on each other, and where collaboration breaks down. You can coach those teams toward working together better.

You know how to improve that life cycle with technology. Maybe you’ve championed internal tools or created automation or scripts.

You also know a process that makes sense on paper won’t get adopted on its own. You can meet people where they are, including the stakeholders who don’t want to change.

You don’t need to be the loudest voice in the room, but you can run a sprint and lead a cross-functional project. If the average person might find this job too undefined or complex, that probably excites you.

Job Responsibilities

  • Mapping a customer's current-state design review and engineering workflows, and defining the target-state process their teams will actually adopt.
  • Deploying and tuning CoLab's AI capabilities against a customer's own standards, drawing checklists, and design guidelines, and diagnosing what's working and what isn't.
  • Providing mechanical engineering expertise to validate AI-generated results and ensure engineering rigor.
  • Investigating and solving complex engineering data and integration challenges across PLM, ERP, QMS, and traditional design feedback tools.
  • Expanding adoption into new teams, programs, and sites within the account, partnering with the Customer Success Manager on where the next opportunity sits.
  • Collaborating with product teams to identify feature gaps, improve capabilities, and refine AutoReview.

Qualifications

Must-haves:

  • Background in mechanical design engineering, ideally in a medium- to large-sized organization.
  • Strong understanding of PLM & ERP systems and enterprise engineering data architecture.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and cross-functional collaborations.
  • Experience working directly with customers or internal stakeholders to solve technical problems.
  • Comfort working in fast-changing, ambiguous environments.
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of high-level AI architecture, specifically LLMs.
  • Familiarity with APIs, data integrations, and enterprise architecture concepts.
  • Located in Switzerland 

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with internal tool development, scripting, or automation.
  • Exposure to AI/ML tools applied to engineering workflows.
  • Prior work in design consulting or product development at scale.

Travel Expectations

While this is a fully remote role, travel is a consistent part of the job. There are two primary types of travel you can expect:

  • Team Weeks: Once per quarter, the sales team or entire company gets together in person. These typically involve traveling out on a Monday and returning on a Thursday or Friday. Two of these each year are held at our headquarters in St. John's, Newfoundland, Canada and the others take place in more central locations that evolve as the team grows.

jobs.jd: We are seeking an Senior Applied Scientist to lead the development of evaluation frameworks and data collection protocols for robotic capabilities. In this role, you will focus on designing how we measure, stress-test, and improve robot behavior across a wide range of real-world tasks. Your work will play a critical role in shaping how policies are validated and how high-quality datasets are generated to accelerate system performance. You will operate at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and human-in-the-loop systems, building the infrastructure and methodologies that connect teleoperation, evaluation, and learning. This includes developing evaluation policies, defining task structures, and contributing to operator-facing interfaces that enable scalable and reliable data collection. The ideal candidate is highly experimental, systems-oriented, and comfortable working across software, robotics, and data pipelines, with a strong focus on turning ambiguous capability goals into measurable and actionable evaluation systems. Key job responsibilities - Design and implement evaluation frameworks to measure robot capabilities across structured tasks, edge cases, and real-world scenarios - Develop task definitions, success criteria, and benchmarking methodologies that enable consistent and reproducible evaluation of policies - Create and refine data collection protocols that generate high-quality, task-relevant datasets aligned with model development needs - Build and iterate on teleoperation workflows and operator interfaces to support efficient, reliable, and scalable data collection - Analyze evaluation results and collected data to identify performance gaps, failure modes, and opportunities for targeted data collection - Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate evaluation tooling, logging systems, and data pipelines into the broader robotics stack - Stay current with advances in robotics, evaluation methodologies, and human-in-the-loop learning to continuously improve internal approaches - Lead technical projects from conception through production deployment - Mentor junior scientists and engineers About the team Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces. We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products. Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful. At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.
